title: Create lead with missing required companyName
rationale: createLead -> normalizeLeadInput -> requiredTrimmed(companyName) throws 'companyName is required'. Confirms the required-field guard rejects an absent companyName rather than persisting a blank lead.

title: Create lead with empty/whitespace companyName
rationale: optionalTrimmed collapses whitespace-only to undefined, so requiredTrimmed throws. Proves trimming happens before the required check (no all-spaces company name).

title: Create lead with serviceTechCount = 0 (below min 1)
rationale: normalizePositiveInteger(serviceTechCount) uses minimum=1 (allowZero false). Off-by-one boundary: 0 must be rejected even though it is a valid integer.

title: Create lead with negative serviceTechCount
rationale: normalizePositiveInteger rejects parsed < minimum. Negative tech count must not be stored.

title: Create lead with non-integer serviceTechCount string
rationale: Number('three') is NaN, so !Number.isInteger throws 'serviceTechCount must be an integer'. Confirms type coercion guard rejects non-numeric input.

title: Create lead with negative truckCount (allowZero field, below 0)
rationale: truckCount uses normalizePositiveInteger(..., allowZero=true) so minimum is 0; -1 is rejected while 0 is accepted. Distinguishes the allowZero boundary from serviceTechCount.

title: Create lead with malformed email
expectMessageContains: email must be a valid email address
rationale: normalizeOptionalEmail tests EMAIL_PATTERN (^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$); 'not-an-email' has no @/dot and is rejected (FR-L-007).

title: Create lead with email exceeding 254 chars
expectMessageContains: email must be a valid email address
rationale: normalizeOptionalEmail rejects trimmed.length > 254. A 10k-char local part exceeds the cap and is refused before any DB write.

title: Create lead with too-short phone (under 7 digits)
expectMessageContains: phone must be a valid phone number
rationale: normalizeOptionalPhone requires 7-15 digits; 5 digits fails the digitCount < 7 check.

title: Create lead with phone containing illegal characters
expectMessageContains: phone must be a valid phone number
rationale: normalizeOptionalPhone rejects any char outside [\d\s+().-]; letters in 'CALL' trip /[^\d\s+().-]/ and the digit count is also short.

title: Create lead with invalid US state/province
expectMessageContains: valid us state or canadian province
rationale: normalizeState calls findLeadRegionOption and throws 'State/Province must be a valid US state or Canadian province' for an unknown code.

title: Create lead with countryCode mismatching state
expectMessageContains: countrycode must match the selected state
rationale: normalizeCountryCode: state 'CA' resolves to country US, but countryCode 'CA' (Canada) differs, so it throws 'countryCode must match the selected state/province'.

title: Create lead with invalid affinityGroupSelection enum
expectMessageContains: must be unknown, none, or group
rationale: normalizeOptionalGroupAxisSelection only accepts unknown|none|group and throws otherwise. 'maybe' is not a member of GROUP_AXIS_SELECTIONS.

title: Create lead with PAN in notes (PCI boundary)
rationale: normalizeLeadInput calls assertNoRawPaymentCardData(notes,'Lead notes'). 4111111111111111 starts with MII 4 and passes Luhn, so it is refused with the PCI message (BR-L-08), not stored.

title: Activity note with PAN obfuscated by spaces/dashes
rationale: logLeadActivityNote calls assertNoRawPaymentCardData(noteText,'Note text'). PAN_CANDIDATE allows single hyphen/space separators, so a dash-grouped Visa is still detected and rejected.

title: Activity note with empty note text
rationale: logLeadActivityNote: optionalTrimmed reduces whitespace to '' and throws 'Note text is required' before any persistence.

title: Activity note with SQL/script injection payload is stored safely
rationale: Note text has no injection-specific validation and is persisted via Prisma (parameterized). A correct system stores it verbatim and returns 201 - it must NOT 500 or execute the payload.

title: Activity note with emoji/unicode is accepted
bodyJson: {"note":"Great call 🚀 — owner is 谢谢 keen, follow up ✅"}
rationale: No character-set restriction on note text; only PCI + non-empty are enforced. Unicode/emoji must round-trip without a 500.

title: Activity note on nonexistent (well-formed) lead id
rationale: logLeadActivityNote throws `Lead not found: <id>` when findUnique returns null; http maps 'not found' messages to 404.

title: Get lead detail with malformed (non-UUID) id
rationale: getLeadDetail with a malformed id: Prisma findUnique either returns null (-> notFound 404) or throws a validation error (-> 400). Either is acceptable for a syntactically bad id; a 500 is not.

title: Backward stage transition without required backwardReason
rationale: transitionLeadStage: when LEAD_STAGE_ORDER[next] < current and no backwardReason, it throws the BR-L-07 reason-required error. Targets a fixture lead at a stage later than 'new'.

title: Stage transition to invalid stage value
rationale: toLeadStageEnum has no case for 'closed_won' and returns undefined; the subsequent LEAD_STAGE_ORDER/update logic fails, surfacing a 400. 'closed_won' is not a member of LEAD_STAGES.

title: Stage transition to the lead's current stage (no-op)
rationale: transitionLeadStage throws 'Lead is already at the requested stage' when current.stage === nextStage. Use a fixture lead currently in 'new'.

title: Park lead lifecycle without required reasonCode
rationale: updateLeadLifecycle: nextStatus !== ACTIVE without reasonCode throws 'A lifecycle reason is required when a lead is parked or closed'.

title: Update lifecycle with invalid status enum
rationale: toLeadLifecycleStatusEnum default branch throws 'Unsupported lead lifecycle status: archived'. 'archived' is not in LEAD_LIFECYCLE_STATUSES.

title: Schedule discovery on a lead not in New stage
rationale: scheduleLeadDiscovery throws 'Discovery can only be scheduled while the lead is in the New Lead stage' when current.stage !== NEW. Target a fixture lead already past 'new'.

title: Schedule discovery with a past scheduledAt
rationale: parseOptionalScheduledAt rejects timestamps older than now-60s with 'scheduledAt must be in the future'. (Requires a 'new'-stage fixture lead.)

title: Schedule discovery with an invalid datetime string
rationale: parseOptionalScheduledAt does new Date(value); NaN getTime throws 'scheduledAt must be a valid ISO datetime'. '31/02/2099' is not parseable.

title: Complete discovery with summary under 10 chars
rationale: normalizeDiscoveryCompletionInput (requireFastTrackReason=false) throws when summary missing or length < 10. 'short' (5 chars) is below the off-by-one boundary.

title: Skip discovery without fastTrackReason
rationale: skipLeadDiscovery -> normalizeDiscoveryCompletionInput(requireFastTrackReason=true) throws 'A fast-track reason is required when discovery is skipped' when fastTrackReason is absent.

title: Complete discovery with active consignment interest but no entry timing
rationale: normalizeDiscoveryCompletionInput requires consignmentEntryTiming when interest is not 'not_discussed'/'declined'; 'interested' without timing throws.

title: SALES_BD_REP cannot approve consignment during discovery
rationale: assertConsignmentLeadActionAccess requires 'lead.consignment_approve' when status is 'approved'. SALES_BD_REP's ROLE_DEFAULT_ACTION_ACCESS lacks that action, so the guard denies (403).

title: Log initial contact twice (second is rejected)
rationale: logLeadInitialContact throws 'Initial contact has already been logged for this lead' when initialContactedAt is set. Run against a fixture lead that already has initial contact logged to assert non-idempotent re-logging is blocked.

title: Bulk import with empty rows array
rationale: importLeads throws 'rows must contain at least one item' when rows is empty. Lower-bound boundary of the batch size.

title: Bulk import with rows omitted entirely
rationale: importLeads: !Array.isArray(input.rows) is true when rows is undefined, throwing the same 'at least one item' error.

title: FINANCE cannot create a lead (intake_manage denied)
rationale: createLead requires 'lead.intake_manage'. FINANCE's ROLE_DEFAULT_ACTION_ACCESS has lead.view/finance actions but NOT lead.intake_manage, so assertActionAccess denies (403).

title: TRAINING_OPS cannot view leads (no leads module)
rationale: listLeads calls assertModuleAccess(role,'leads'). TRAINING_OPS's ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS does not include 'leads', so the module guard denies before any data is returned.

title: DEALER cannot list leads
rationale: DEALER_PORTAL_USER has only dealer_portal module + dealer.* actions; it lacks the leads module and lead.view, so listLeads denies (403).

title: REGIONAL_DIRECTOR cannot edit a lead (read-only on leads)
rationale: updateLead requires 'lead.intake_manage'. REGIONAL_DIRECTOR has lead.view but not lead.intake_manage, so the PATCH is denied (403) - confirms RD lead access is read-only.

title: SALES_BD_REP cannot update lead routing policy (reference.manage)
rationale: updateLeadRoutingPolicy requires 'reference.manage', granted only to ADMIN_CSR_OPS/SUPER_ADMIN. SALES_BD_REP lacks it, so the policy PATCH is denied (403).

title: Routing policy update with strategicGrowthMax = 0
rationale: updateLeadRoutingPolicy: normalizePositiveInteger(0) returns 0 (allowZero default false actually rejects 0 first) and the explicit `< 1` guard throws 'strategicGrowthMax must be at least 1'.

title: Routing policy update with empty body (no fields)
expectMessageContains: at least one field must be provided
rationale: updateLeadRoutingPolicy throws 'At least one field must be provided' when no recognized field is supplied (Object.keys(data).length === 0).

title: Create lead contact with invalid role enum
rationale: createLeadContact -> toLeadContactRoleEnum('ceo') hits the assertNever default and throws; 'ceo' is not a member of LEAD_CONTACT_ROLES. http maps the thrown error to 400.

title: Create lead contact with missing displayName
rationale: createLeadContact: optionalTrimmed(displayName) is undefined -> throws 'displayName is required' before the lead lookup.

title: Create lead contact on nonexistent lead
rationale: createLeadContact throws `Lead not found: <id>` inside the transaction when the lead lookup is null; http maps to 404.

title: Update readiness item with nonexistent itemId
rationale: updateLeadReadinessItem throws 'Readiness checklist item not found for lead: <leadId>' when the item is missing or its checklist.leadId !== leadId; http maps to 404.

title: Update readiness item with invalid status enum
rationale: toChecklistItemStatusEnum('done') hits assertNever and throws (400). If the item lookup runs first the missing item yields 404; either rejection is correct for this invalid combination, not a 500.

title: Update readiness item with invalid dueAt timestamp
rationale: parseOptionalDate -> parseRequiredDate throws 'dueAt must be a valid ISO timestamp' for an unparseable value. (Item lookup may surface 404 first since {{nonexistentId}} is used; both are acceptable, never 500.)

title: Create lead matching an existing one without duplicateResolution
rationale: createLead: findLeadImportDuplicateCandidates matches on email/phone/(companyName+state); when candidates exist and no duplicateResolution is supplied it throws 'Potential duplicate found...'. Provision a seed lead with this email first.

title: Create lead with enrich_existing resolution missing targetEntityId
rationale: normalizeManualDuplicateResolution throws 'duplicateResolution.targetEntityId is required when enriching an existing lead' for enrich_existing without a target.

title: Create lead with unsupported duplicateResolution decision
rationale: normalizeManualDuplicateResolution only accepts create_new|enrich_existing; 'merge' throws 'Unsupported manual duplicate-resolution decision: merge'.

title: Preview duplicate candidates returns safely (no 500) for known fixture
rationale: previewLeadDuplicateCandidates requires lead.intake_manage (SALES_BD_REP has it) and returns {hasPotentialDuplicate,candidates}. It must 200 (probe), never mutate or 500, even when a matching fixture exists.

title: FINANCE denied on duplicate preview (intake-only, not read)
rationale: previewLeadDuplicateCandidates intentionally gates on lead.intake_manage (comment: gating as read let scoped roles enumerate cross-territory candidates). FINANCE has lead.view but not intake_manage -> 403.

title: List leads with oversize limit is clamped (no error)
rationale: normalizeLimit clamps to Math.min(value,200); an absurd limit is silently capped, so the endpoint returns 200 with at most 200 items rather than erroring or dumping the table.

title: List leads with negative page is floored to first page
rationale: listLeads uses Math.max(0, query.page) so a negative page becomes page 0; the request succeeds (200) rather than producing a negative skip/SQL error.

title: List leads with invalid stage filter value
rationale: listLeads casts the stage query then toLeadStageEnum maps it; 'closed_won' has no case and yields undefined, causing a 400 rather than silently ignoring the unknown filter or 500.

title: List leads with SQL-injection search term is handled safely
rationale: search feeds Prisma `contains` (parameterized) across companyName/email/phone/group names. The injection string is treated as a literal substring, returning 200 (likely empty), never executing SQL or 500ing.

title: FINANCE cannot convert lead on first order (customer.create denied)
rationale: convertLeadOnFirstOrder asserts module 'customers' + action 'customer.create'. FINANCE lacks customer.create, so conversion is denied (403) before any account is created.

title: Convert a not-ready lead on first order is blocked
rationale: convertLeadOnFirstOrder refreshes readiness and throws `Lead is not ready for conversion: <blockers>` when status !== 'ready'. A freshly created fixture lead has incomplete readiness, so conversion is refused (no account created).

title: Convert lead with invalid firstOrderConfirmedAt
rationale: parseRequiredDate('yesterday') is NaN and throws 'firstOrderConfirmedAt must be a valid ISO timestamp'. (Lead must be visible to the actor; an unparseable date is rejected regardless of readiness.)

title: Create lead with companyName at huge length
rationale: companyName has no explicit max-length guard in normalizeLeadInput, so a correct system either accepts it (201) or rejects via a DB column limit surfaced as 400 - it must not 500. Probes for an oversize-text safeguard.

title: List leads with no authentication token
rationale: requireAuthenticatedActor runs before any handler logic; with no/invalid credentials it raises an authentication error mapped to 401 (or 403). Confirms the leads list is not anonymously reachable. (Harness should send this request without a valid session.)

title: Public website capture is idempotent — duplicate submission attaches, not double-creates
rationale: captureWebsiteLead -> findWebsiteLeadDuplicate attaches a repeat submission to the existing lead (ATTACHED_TO_EXISTING_LEAD) instead of creating a second lead. A correct system returns 201 with the linked lead; origin gating may yield 403 and rate-limit 429 - but never a duplicate lead or 500. Repeat the same payload to assert no second lead is created.

title: Public website capture with invalid leadType
rationale: captureWebsiteLead -> toWebsiteLeadTypeEnum('reseller') throws 'Unknown website lead type: reseller' (400). If the request origin is not allow-listed the origin guard returns 403 first; both are valid rejections, not 500.

title: Public website capture for inactive/nonexistent site
rationale: captureWebsiteLead throws 'Website lead form is not active for this site' when the site is missing or inactive (mapped to 400). Origin enforcement may short-circuit to 403; neither should 500 nor create a lead.

title: Non-SUPER_ADMIN cannot directly create an account even with customer.create
rationale: createAccount() (service.ts L155-157) hard-blocks every role except SUPER_ADMIN with the message 'Direct customer creation is reserved for bootstrap or migration workflows...'. SALES_BD_REP holds the customer.create action so it passes the RBAC gate, then is rejected by this business rule. Proves the SUPER_ADMIN-only guard is enforced server-side, not just hidden in UI.

title: DEALER role denied account list (no customers module access)
rationale: listAccounts calls assertModuleAccess(role,'customers'). DEALER_PORTAL_USER's ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS (auth.ts) is ['home','calendar','dealer_portal','notifications'] — no 'customers'. Must be denied before any data is returned, confirming external dealer users cannot enumerate the customer book.

title: TRAINING_OPS denied account list (lacks customer.view)
rationale: TRAINING_OPS ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS has no 'customers' and ROLE_DEFAULT_ACTION_ACCESS has no 'customer.view'. assertModuleAccess/assertActionAccess in listAccounts must reject. Confirms training operations staff have zero customer visibility.

title: EXECUTIVE (read-only) cannot edit an account
rationale: EXECUTIVE was hardened (2026-06-22) to oversight/read-only: ROLE_DEFAULT_ACTION_ACCESS lists customer.view + customer.financials_view but NOT customer.edit. updateAccount asserts customer.edit and must 403. Proves the read-only executive contract holds for mutations.

title: REGIONAL_DIRECTOR cannot edit accounts (view-only customer access)
rationale: REGIONAL_DIRECTOR action set (auth.ts L365) contains customer.view but deliberately omits customer.edit/create/contact.create/location.create. updateAccount asserts customer.edit → 403. Confirms RDs are read-only on the customer book despite broad territory powers.

title: SALES_BD_REP denied viewing payment methods (no financials_view)
rationale: listAccountPaymentMethods asserts customer.financials_view. SALES_BD_REP action set lacks it (only FINANCE/EXECUTIVE/SUPER_ADMIN have financials_view). Must 403, confirming financial vault data is masked from frontline reps at the route level, not just in response shaping (financials.ts).

title: TERRITORY_MANAGER cannot manage payment methods (no financials_manage)
rationale: createAccountPaymentMethod asserts customer.financials_manage, held only by FINANCE and SUPER_ADMIN. TERRITORY_MANAGER lacks it → 403. Confirms payment-method creation is finance-gated.

title: Create account with whitespace-only displayName is rejected
rationale: createAccount trims displayName (L159) and throws 'displayName is required' when the trimmed value is empty. A whitespace-only string must be treated as missing, not silently stored. Tests the boundary between present-but-blank and absent.

title: Create account with no displayName at all
rationale: displayName is the only hard-required field on account creation. Omitting it entirely must throw 'displayName is required' (L160-162). Confirms required-field enforcement when the key is absent rather than blank.

title: Create account with 100k-char displayName
rationale: displayName has no explicit max-length cap in service.ts, so a 100k-char value will hit either a DB column limit (Prisma/Postgres) or a request-body size guard. A correct system rejects with 400/413/422 rather than a 500 stack trace or unbounded storage. Probes the absent length boundary.

title: Create account with emoji/unicode displayName is accepted and round-trips
rationale: displayName is free text with only a trim/non-empty check, so multibyte unicode + emoji must persist as-is (no mojibake, no 500). Confirms UTF-8 handling end-to-end for a legitimately valid name.

title: SQL-injection payload in account search is handled safely
rationale: search feeds a parameterized Prisma contains filter (L123-128). The classic '; DROP TABLE accounts;-- payload must be treated as a literal search string returning 200 with (likely empty) results, never a 500 or executed SQL. Verifies parameterization, not string concatenation.

title: Script payload in displayName stored as inert text (no 500)
rationale: displayName has no HTML/script rejection — it is a stored text field. The API must persist it verbatim (201) without executing or 500ing; output-encoding is the client's responsibility. Confirms the API neither crashes nor mangles script-like input.

title: PAN in account legalName must be rejected with payment-card message
rationale: A Luhn-valid PAN ({{PAN}}) embedded in a free-text field must be rejected per the project PCI hard-block (utils/pci.ts assertNoRawPaymentCardData, message contains 'payment card'). NOTE: accounts/service.ts does NOT currently import the PCI guard for legalName, so a CORRECT system rejects but the live deployment may wrongly store it — this case surfaces that gap.

title: PAN in churn lifecycle reason note must be rejected
rationale: lifecycleReasonNote is operator free-text written into the account and audit log. A PAN here must be rejected with the payment-card message. The lifecycle service does not call the PCI guard, so a correct system rejects and the live deployment may not — high-value PCI leak surface to verify.

title: PAN in contact title must be rejected
rationale: Contact title is a free-text field persisted without PCI scrubbing in createAccountContact. A correct system must reject a Luhn-valid PAN with the payment-card message rather than store cardholder data. Confirms PCI coverage extends to nested contact creation.

title: Illegal lifecycle transition ACTIVE -> CHURNED is blocked
rationale: validateAccountLifecycleTransition (L2088-2103) allows ACTIVE only to AT_RISK or INACTIVE. An account must pass through INACTIVE before CHURNED. A fresh fixture is ACTIVE, so ACTIVE->CHURNED must throw 'Lifecycle transition is not allowed: active -> churned'. Core state-machine guard.

title: Legal lifecycle transition ACTIVE -> INACTIVE succeeds (positive control)
rationale: ACTIVE->INACTIVE is a legal transition and INACTIVE does NOT require a reason note (only CHURNED does, L410-412). This positive control confirms the legal path succeeds (200) and isolates the churn-note rule tested separately — preventing false positives where any lifecycle PATCH is wrongly rejected.

title: CHURNED requires a non-empty reason note
rationale: normalizeNullableText trims the note to null; when nextLifecycleStatus===CHURNED and the note is blank, the service throws 'A lifecycle note is required before an account can be marked as churned' (L410-412). Whitespace-only must count as missing. (On an ACTIVE fixture the transition guard fires first; on an INACTIVE fixture this note rule is the targeted assertion.)

title: Invalid lifecycleStatus enum value is rejected
rationale: toAccountLifecycleStatusEnum (L2062-2073) only maps active/at_risk/inactive/churned; an unknown key like 'deleted' returns undefined and downstream the Prisma update receives undefined status, which must surface as a 400 rather than silently no-op or 500. Validates enum allow-listing for lifecycle.

title: Invalid lifecycleStatus query filter on list
rationale: http.ts casts the raw lifecycleStatus query param straight into ListAccountsRequest; listAccounts then calls toAccountLifecycleStatusEnum which returns undefined for 'zombie', so the where-clause filter is dropped (200 unfiltered) — or a stricter system 400s. Either is defensible; a 500 is not. Probes loose query-enum handling.

title: List with limit=0 is rejected (positive-integer rule)
expectMessageContains: limit must be a positive integer
rationale: normalizeLimit (L2260-2270) throws 'limit must be a positive integer' for limit<=0. Zero is the off-by-one boundary against the smallest valid value (1). Confirms the lower bound is exclusive of 0.

title: List with negative offset is rejected
expectMessageContains: offset must be a non-negative integer
rationale: normalizeOffset (L2272-2282) throws 'offset must be a non-negative integer' for offset<0. (http.ts parseInteger keeps -5 since it IS an integer, so it reaches the service rule.) Validates the non-negative lower bound on pagination offset.

title: List with limit above the 100 cap is clamped, not rejected
rationale: normalizeLimit returns Math.min(limit,100) for any positive integer, so a huge limit must succeed (200) with at most 100 rows rather than error or attempt an unbounded scan. Confirms the upper bound is a silent clamp, protecting the DB from oversized page requests.

title: Non-integer limit query param is ignored (falls back to default)
rationale: http.ts parseInteger returns undefined when Number('abc') is not an integer, so limit is omitted and normalizeLimit defaults to 25. A non-numeric limit must therefore yield 200 with the default page, never a 400/500. Confirms tolerant coercion of malformed pagination params at the HTTP layer.

title: Get detail for a well-formed but nonexistent account id returns 404
rationale: getAccountDetail returns null when findFirst finds nothing, and http.ts maps null to notFoundResponse(404). A syntactically valid UUID that does not exist must be a clean 404, not 500. Baseline not-found behavior.

title: Malformed (non-UUID) account id on detail route
rationale: The route regex /accounts/[^/]+ matches any non-slash segment, so 'not-a-uuid-123' reaches the service. Prisma findFirst on a malformed id either throws (caught -> 400) or simply finds nothing (-> 404). Both are acceptable; a 500 leaking a Prisma error is not. Probes malformed-id handling.

title: Create contact missing lastName is rejected
rationale: createAccountContact (L1134-1138) trims firstName/lastName and throws 'firstName and lastName are required' if either is empty/absent. Omitting lastName must reject. Confirms both name parts are mandatory on contact creation.

title: Create contact with whitespace-only lastName rejected
rationale: The trim+truthiness check means a whitespace-only lastName collapses to empty and triggers the same required-field error. Distinguishes present-but-blank from valid, ensuring blank names cannot be persisted.

title: Create contact referencing a locationId from another account is rejected
expectMessageContains: locationid does not belong to this account
rationale: createAccountContact (L1157-1168) looks up the locationId scoped to this account and throws 'locationId does not belong to this account' when it is not found under {{accountId}}. Using an unrelated id ({{siteId}}) must reject, preventing cross-account contact linkage / IDOR.

title: Create location on a nonexistent account returns 404
rationale: createAccountLocation calls assertAccountMutationInScope which throws 'Account not found: <id>' for an unknown/out-of-scope account; http.ts maps a message containing 'not found' to 404. Confirms child-resource creation is gated on parent existence.

title: Create location with no identity fields (code/name/line1) is rejected
expectMessageContains: locationcode, name, or line1 is required
rationale: createAccountLocation (L924-927) requires at least one of locationCode/name/line1 (hasIdentity). A body with only city/state and no identity must throw 'locationCode, name, or line1 is required'. Confirms a location cannot be created as an anonymous geo blob.

title: Create payment method with no tokenized reference is rejected
expectMessageContains: at least one tokenized payment reference is required
rationale: createAccountPaymentMethod (L701-703) requires vaultToken OR vaultCustomerRef OR externalPaymentMethodRef when not promoting from CIS. A body with only provider+zip must throw 'At least one tokenized payment reference is required'. Confirms the tokenization invariant (no raw card, must reference a vault token).

title: Promote payment method from a nonexistent CIS vault reference
rationale: When sourceCisVaultReferenceId is supplied, the service looks it up and throws 'sourceCisVaultReferenceId was not found' if absent (L610-612). The error lacks the 'not found:' colon pattern http.ts keys on for 404, so it may surface as 400 — but a well-behaved system rejects the dangling reference. Validates referential integrity on CIS promotion.

title: Repeated identical CIS promotion does not create a duplicate payment method
rationale: createAccountPaymentMethod dedups CIS promotions by (accountId, sourceCisVaultReferenceId): an existing row is UPDATED in place, not duplicated (L618-650). Re-POSTing the same source must be idempotent. With a nonexistent source this resolves to the same 'not found' rejection on every call — proving repeated promotion is safe and deterministic, never a silent second insert.

title: Update payment method on an id not under this account returns not-found
rationale: updateAccountPaymentMethod first loads the method scoped to the account and throws 'Account payment method not found: <id>' for a bad id, before reaching the 'status cannot be empty' check (L780-781, L794-798). With {{nonexistentId}} the not-found guard fires first. Confirms the method must exist and is account-scoped before any field update — IDOR-safe.

title: Empty PATCH body on account is a safe no-op (200), not an error
rationale: updateAccount builds a data object from provided fields; when none are present Object.keys(data).length===0 returns the existing summary unchanged (L314-316) without writing or auditing. An empty PATCH must be a benign idempotent 200 read-back, not a 400. Confirms partial-update semantics tolerate empty payloads.

title: Update account display name to whitespace-only is rejected
rationale: updateAccount (L239-244) trims a provided displayName and throws 'displayName cannot be empty' if blank. Unlike omission (allowed), an explicit blank displayName must reject — you cannot erase the required name. Tests the present-but-blank edit boundary.

title: Connect a nonexistent brand label on account update is rejected
rationale: updateAccount (L262-269) looks up brandLabelRef and throws 'Brand label not found: <id>' when absent. The message lacks the lowercase 'not found:' colon pattern http.ts uses, so it may map to 400; either way the dangling FK must be rejected. Validates referential integrity on brand label connect.

title: Affinity group ref supplied while selection is not 'group' is rejected
rationale: resolveGroupAxis (group-classification.ts L121-124) throws 'affinityGroupId/code/name can only be supplied when affinityGroupSelection is "group"' when a ref is provided with selection 'none'. The harness confirms the axis-consistency rule is enforced (a correct system rejects the contradictory selection+ref combo) rather than silently dropping the ref.

title: Invalid affinityGroupSelection enum value is rejected
rationale: toGroupAxisSelectionEnum (group-classification.ts L213) throws 'Unsupported affinityGroupSelection value: maybe' for any key outside group/none/unknown. updateAccount routes the input through resolveAccountClassificationInput, so an invalid selection enum must reject rather than default silently.

title: Patch a contact id that belongs to a different account returns not-found
rationale: updateAccountContact does findFirst({id, accountId}) and throws 'Contact not found: <id>' when the contact is not under this account (L1245-1252); http.ts maps 'not found' to 404. A contact id not tied to {{accountId}} must 404, blocking cross-account edits (IDOR).

title: Contact email is lowercased on create (case-normalization round-trip)
rationale: createAccountContact lowercases email (L1174: optionalTrimmed(...).toLowerCase()). A mixed-case address must be accepted (201) and stored/returned as qa.person@example.com. Confirms deterministic email normalization so duplicate detection and lookups are case-insensitive.

title: DELETE on account detail route returns 405 (no hard-delete endpoint)
rationale: The account detail route only handles GET and PATCH; any other method falls through to methodNotAllowedResponse(res, method, ['GET','PATCH']) (http.ts L141). DELETE must return 405 (accounts are deactivated via lifecycle, never hard-deleted). Confirms there is no destructive delete endpoint and method allow-listing is enforced. Safe: targets a QA fixture and is rejected before any mutation.

title: Re-applying the same lifecycle status is an accepted no-op transition
rationale: validateAccountLifecycleTransition returns early when current===next (L2089-2091), so setting a fresh ACTIVE fixture to 'active' again is allowed and idempotent (200). Confirms repeating the same status is not treated as an illegal transition, and active does not require a reason note.

title: Create region with empty name rejected
rationale: createRegion calls requireText(input.name,'name'); optionalText trims whitespace to undefined and throws 'name is required'. Whitespace-only name must be rejected, not stored.

title: Create region with symbol-only code rejected
rationale: normalizeCode strips all non-alphanumerics to underscores then strips leading/trailing underscores; a symbol-only code collapses to '' and throws 'code is required'. Proves code normalization rejects empty result.

title: Create region with no code field rejected
rationale: Missing code is undefined; normalizeCode->requireText throws 'code is required'. Required-field enforcement at boundary.

title: Create region with non-existent directorUserId rejected
rationale: validateOptionalUserId looks up the user and throws 'Unknown or inactive user' for a missing id. A well-formed-but-nonexistent FK must be rejected (thrown error maps to 400, not 404).

title: Region notes with SQL/script payload stored safely
rationale: notes is free text passed through optionalText only; Prisma parameterizes the insert. Must persist verbatim with 201 and no 500 — proves no SQL injection and no crash on dangerous characters.

title: Region name with emoji/unicode accepted
rationale: requireText only trims; multibyte unicode/emoji is a valid non-empty name. Confirms UTF-8 handling without corruption or 500.

title: Region notes oversize payload handled
rationale: No explicit length cap on notes in service code; behaviour depends on DB column/body-size limits. A correct system either stores it (201) or rejects cleanly (400/413) — never a 500. Surfaces any unbounded-text weakness.

title: FINANCE denied region creation (no territories module)
rationale: ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS.FINANCE excludes 'territories'; assertModuleAccess throws AuthorizationError->403 before any action check. Module gate must deny.

title: TERRITORY_MANAGER denied region creation (lacks territory.admin)
rationale: TERRITORY_MANAGER has module access but ROLE_DEFAULT_ACTION_ACCESS lacks 'territory.admin'; assertActionAccess throws->403. Action gate must deny even with module access.

title: DEALER denied region list (no territories module)
rationale: DEALER_PORTAL_USER module access is dealer_portal only; listRegions asserts module 'territories' and throws AuthorizationError->403. Portal users must never enumerate internal regions.

title: Patch non-existent region returns 404
rationale: updateRegion findFirst returns null for a well-formed missing id; http handler returns 404 'Region not found'. Distinguishes missing record from malformed input.

title: Create territory missing regionId rejected
rationale: createTerritory calls requireRegion(input.regionId); undefined regionId fails the findUnique and throws 'Unknown or inactive region'. Mandatory FK must be validated.

title: Create territory with non-existent regionId rejected
rationale: requireRegion throws for a well-formed-but-missing region id; error surfaces as 400 (thrown generic error path), not a silent create. Validates referential integrity at create.

title: Create territory with non-TM managerUserId rejected
rationale: createTerritory uses validateOptionalUserId(managerUserId) which throws 'Unknown or inactive user' for a missing id. Manager must reference a real active user.

title: Create territory with inactive/unknown shippingCenterId rejected
rationale: validateOptionalShippingCenterId throws 'Unknown or inactive shipping center' for a missing/inactive center. Prevents binding a territory to a non-existent SC.

title: Territory name with script payload stored safely
rationale: name is non-empty after trim and stored via parameterized Prisma write; output encoding is a UI concern. Server must accept and persist without executing or 500-ing.

title: EXECUTIVE denied territory creation (read-only oversight)
rationale: EXECUTIVE has 'territories' module access but its action list (hardened 2026-06-22) omits 'territory.admin'; assertActionAccess->403. Oversight role must not mutate.

title: Patch non-existent territory returns 404
rationale: updateTerritory findFirst returns null for a missing id; handler returns 404 'Territory not found'. Confirms not-found path over silent no-op.

title: Move territory to non-existent region rejected
rationale: updateTerritory, when regionId provided, calls requireRegion which throws 'Unknown or inactive region'. Re-parenting to a bad region must fail validation.

title: Coverage with invalid state code rejected
expectMessageContains: valid us state or canadian province
rationale: replaceTerritoryCoverage normalizes each stateCode via findLeadRegionOption; 'ZZ' resolves to undefined and throws 'State/Province must be a valid US state or Canadian province'. Enum-like state set is enforced.

title: Coverage with numeric state code rejected
expectMessageContains: valid us state or canadian province
rationale: '99' is not a state value or label in LEAD_REGION_OPTIONS; normalizeStateCode returns undefined and the coverage loop throws. Validates rejection of out-of-set tokens.

title: Coverage with duplicate states within request collapses (no error)
rationale: Input is deduped through a Map keyed 'COUNTRY:STATE' before insert and 'california' resolves to 'CA'; duplicates collapse to one entry rather than erroring. Confirms idempotent intra-request dedup and label-vs-code normalization.

title: Coverage already owned by another territory rejected
rationale: validateCoverageConflicts throws 'Coverage already exists for US:XX' when a state is already mapped to a different territory. Either the QA territory legitimately owns all listed states (200) or the conflict guard fires (400) — proves unique state-to-territory mapping is enforced and no 500.

title: Replacing coverage with identical set is idempotent
rationale: PUT deletes all rows for the territory then recreates; the conflict check excludes the same territoryId, so re-PUTing the territory's own current set yields 200 (idempotent). If CA belongs to another territory it 400s with the conflict message. Confirms self-replace is safe and repeatable.

title: TERRITORY_MANAGER denied coverage replace (lacks territory.admin)
rationale: replaceTerritoryCoverage asserts 'territory.admin'; TERRITORY_MANAGER lacks it->403. Coverage edits are RD/admin only.

title: Coverage with empty array clears all states
rationale: Empty coverage is valid: deleteMany runs and the createMany is skipped (length>0 guard). Min-boundary input must succeed and leave the territory with zero covered states, not error.

title: Reassign lead to inactive/unknown territory rejected
rationale: requireVisibleTargetTerritory throws 'Unknown, inactive, or inaccessible territory' when the target territory id is missing/inactive/out-of-scope. Target validity is enforced before any override write.

title: Reassign lead missing reasonCode rejected
rationale: reassignLeadTerritory calls requireText(input.reasonCode,'reasonCode'); absent reasonCode throws 'reasonCode is required'. Audit reason is mandatory on overrides.

title: Reassign non-existent lead returns 404
rationale: reassignLeadTerritory returns null when the lead lookup misses; handler returns 404 'Lead not found'. Missing entity is 404, distinct from the 400 thrown for a bad target territory.

title: Reassign lead with wrong-role assignedTmUserId rejected
rationale: validateOptionalTerritoryOwnerUserId requires assignedTmUserId to resolve to an active INTERNAL user whose role is TERRITORY_MANAGER, else throws 'Selected user must have role TERRITORY_MANAGER'. A non-TM user must 400; only if fixture {{userId}} happens to be a TM does it 200.

title: EXECUTIVE denied lead reassignment (lacks territory.reassign)
rationale: reassignLeadTerritory asserts 'territory.reassign'; EXECUTIVE has module access but not this action->403. Read-only oversight cannot move records.

title: Reassign reasonNote with PAN is stored without PCI rejection (gap probe)
rationale: The territories module never imports utils/pci.ts (unlike training/reference), so a {{PAN}} in reasonNote is currently persisted verbatim with 200 — a PCI leakage gap. A hardened system would reject free-text containing a card number with a 'payment card' message (400/422). Flags whether PCI scrubbing should extend to territory reason notes.

title: Bulk reassign leads with empty array rejected
expectMessageContains: at least one lead is required
rationale: bulkReassignLeadTerritories filters/dedupes leadIds then throws 'At least one lead is required' when none remain. Empty bulk payload must be rejected before any DB work.

title: Bulk reassign leads with whitespace-only ids rejected
expectMessageContains: at least one lead is required
rationale: Each id is trimmed and zero-length entries are filtered out, leaving an empty set -> 'At least one lead is required'. Confirms blank-id padding cannot sneak past the non-empty guard.

title: Bulk reassign leads with one missing id rejected atomically
rationale: After fetching, leads.length !== leadIds.length triggers 'Lead not found: {id}' (thrown->400). The whole bulk operation must fail atomically when any member id is invalid, not partially apply.

title: Bulk reassign leads dedupes repeated ids
rationale: leadIds are passed through new Set() so repeats collapse to one; the response should contain a single lead assignment summary. Verifies duplicate-id idempotency in the bulk path without double-processing.

title: SALES_BD_REP denied bulk account reassignment
rationale: SALES_BD_REP lacks the 'territories' module entirely; assertModuleAccess->403 before reassign action is evaluated. Reps cannot bulk-move territory assignments.

title: Bulk reassign accounts with missing id rejected atomically
rationale: bulkReassignAccountTerritories throws 'Account not found: {id}' when fetched count differs from requested; the transaction never starts. Ensures no partial reassignment on a bad member id.

title: History with invalid entityType rejected
expectMessageContains: entitytype must be lead, account, or location
rationale: The history route validates entityType against ['lead','account','location'] before the auth handler; 'widget' returns 400 'entityType must be lead, account, or location'. Enum query param is whitelisted.

title: History missing entityId rejected
rationale: Both entityType and entityId are required query params; absent entityId returns 400 'entityType and entityId are required'. Required-query enforcement at the route level.

title: History for non-existent entity is empty or denied, not 500
rationale: assertTerritoryAssignmentHistoryVisible runs before the findMany; a well-formed missing entity should yield an empty list (200) or a visibility denial (403/404), never a 500. Probes graceful handling of unknown entityId.

title: EXECUTIVE denied assignable-users roster (lacks territory.reassign)
rationale: listTerritoryAssignableUsers is gated on 'territory.reassign' (not module access alone) because it exposes the internal TM/RD roster; EXECUTIVE lacks that action->403. Confirms the roster is not leaked to read-only roles.

title: TRAINING_OPS denied territory dashboard
rationale: TRAINING_OPS module list excludes 'territories'; getTerritoryDashboard asserts module 'territories'->403. Cross-module isolation for an unrelated ops role.

title: DELETE on territory rejected as method not allowed
rationale: The /territories/:id handler only supports PATCH (and PUT for coverage); any other method returns methodNotAllowedResponse with Allow: PATCH. Territories have no hard-delete endpoint, so DELETE must be 405, confirming deactivation-only lifecycle.

title: Malformed (non-UUID) territory id on PATCH
rationale: A syntactically invalid id either fails Prisma's findFirst type-coercion (->thrown->400) or simply matches nothing (->null->404). A correct system returns one of these, never 500 or a silent success.

title: Create shipping center missing name rejected
rationale: createShippingCenter calls requireText(input.name,'name'); missing name throws 'name is required'. Required field enforced for SC creation.

title: Create shipping center with invalid state code is normalized away
rationale: normalizeStateCode('ZZ') returns undefined; on create the value is conditionally spread so an undefined state is simply omitted (201 with no state) rather than thrown. Verifies the invalid 'ZZ' is never persisted as a state — a correct system either drops it (201, state absent) or rejects (400), never stores 'ZZ'.

title: Update policy with wrong type for boolean flag
rationale: updateTerritoryPolicy spreads preHandoffTmVisibility straight to Prisma when !== undefined; a non-boolean 'yes' should be rejected by Prisma's type validation (->400) rather than coerced. Verifies the boolean policy flag is type-safe and a string does not silently become true.

title: SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP denied policy update
rationale: SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP has no 'territories' module; updateTerritoryPolicy asserts module access first->403. Policy is global config restricted to territory admins.

title: Policy notes with injection payload stored safely
rationale: Policy notes goes through optionalText then a parameterized Prisma update; the payload must persist verbatim and return 200, proving no SQL injection and no crash. Also triggers refreshLeadTerritoryAssignments, so the write must remain transactionally safe.

title: REGIONAL_DIRECTOR scoped coverage replace (in-scope 200 / out-of-scope 404)
rationale: REGIONAL_DIRECTOR holds 'territory.admin' but is scoped: buildTerritoryReadScope confines them to their region, so an in-scope territory yields 200 (empty coverage) while an out-of-scope {{territoryId}} reads as 404 (not 403), per the documented not-found-on-scope-miss design. Confirms scoped-admin behaviour rather than a blanket allow.

title: Reassign account missing territoryId rejected
rationale: requireVisibleTargetTerritory(actor, undefined) cannot find a territory and throws 'Unknown, inactive, or inaccessible territory'. The mandatory target territoryId is enforced before the override upsert.

title: Create session with a past scheduledAt is rejected
expectMessageContains: scheduledat must be in the future
rationale: createTrainingSession throws 'scheduledAt must be in the future' when scheduledAt.getTime() < Date.now() - 60_000. A correct system rejects past sessions with 400; the >60s past guard fires, proving the boundary is enforced.

title: Create session with malformed scheduledAt is rejected as invalid ISO
expectMessageContains: scheduledat must be a valid iso date
rationale: parseIsoDate('not-a-date','scheduledAt') yields NaN time and throws 'scheduledAt must be a valid ISO date'. Confirms malformed dates are caught before any DB write.

title: Create session with durationMinutes=0 is rejected
expectMessageContains: durationminutes must be greater than zero
rationale: createTrainingSession checks `input.durationMinutes <= 0`. Zero is the off-by-one boundary and must throw 'durationMinutes must be greater than zero'.

title: Create session with negative durationMinutes is rejected
expectMessageContains: durationminutes must be greater than zero
rationale: Negative durations also fail the `durationMinutes <= 0` guard. Confirms negative numeric input is rejected, not silently stored.

title: Create session against a nonexistent account returns 404
rationale: requireVisibleTrainingAccount throws 'Account not found'; http.ts maps any 'not found' message to 404. A well-formed but nonexistent UUID must yield 404, not 500.

title: Create session with a malformed (non-UUID) account id
rationale: Prisma findFirst on a malformed id returns null -> 'Account not found' (404), unless the id triggers a query error (400). A correct system must not 500 on a syntactically bad id.

title: Create session referencing a nonexistent trainer is rejected
rationale: ensureAssignableTrainer throws 'Trainer not found' when the user does not exist or is inactive. 'not found' maps to 404 in http.ts; either 400/404 is acceptable since it is a body field, not the path entity.

title: Create session with an ineligible trainer role is rejected
rationale: ensureAssignableTrainer only allows roleCode in {TRAINING_OPS, TERRITORY_MANAGER, REGIONAL_DIRECTOR}; any other user throws 'Selected user is not eligible to deliver training sessions'. {{userId}} is a generic (likely non-trainer) user, validating the eligibility gate.

title: Create session missing required trainerUserId
rationale: trainerUserId is required by the contract. With it absent, ensureAssignableTrainer(undefined) finds no user and throws 'Trainer not found'. Must fail, not create a trainer-less session.

title: Create session with a program belonging to a different account
rationale: A nonexistent programId throws 'Training program not found'; a real program on another account throws 'does not belong to the selected account'. Validates cross-account program binding is blocked.

title: Create session with an invalid activityKind enum
rationale: toTrainingActivityKind uppercases and checks the TrainingActivityKind enum; 'HACKATHON' is absent and throws 'Unsupported training activity kind: hackathon'. Confirms enum whitelist enforcement.

title: Create session with SQL/script payload in notes is stored safely
rationale: notes is free text persisted via Prisma (parameterized). The payload must be stored verbatim with no SQL execution and no 500 — proving injection is neutralized, not that the input is rejected.

title: PAN in session notes is accepted as plain text (module has no card scope)
rationale: The Training module contains NO PAN/PCI detection in service.ts (the only 'pan' is the 'pan_treatments' training type). Per the code as written, the PAN string is stored as ordinary note text and returns 201. This case documents a real PCI gap: a hardened system would reject card numbers, so a 201 here flags missing scrubbing for follow-up.

title: Create session with a 10k-char notes field
rationale: There is no explicit length cap on notes in createTrainingSession, so a 10k string is accepted (201) unless the DB column length rejects it (400). Either way it must not 500; this probes unbounded free-text handling.

title: Create session with emoji/unicode title and notes
rationale: title/notes are trimmed and stored; multibyte unicode and emoji must round-trip without corruption or error (201), confirming UTF-8 safe persistence.

title: DEALER cannot create a training session (no schedule action)
rationale: DEALER_PORTAL_USER has no 'training.schedule' in ROLE_DEFAULT_ACTION_ACCESS; the route requires action 'training.schedule' so requireAuthenticatedActor / assertActionAccess throws AuthorizationError -> 403.

title: FINANCE cannot list training sessions (no training module)
rationale: FINANCE module access list excludes 'training'; the GET sessions route requires module 'training', so assertModuleAccess throws AuthorizationError -> 403.

title: EXECUTIVE (read-only) cannot create a session via schedule action
rationale: EXECUTIVE has module visibility to training but the hardened ROLE_DEFAULT_ACTION_ACCESS for EXECUTIVE omits 'training.schedule' (oversight/read role). Mutation must be denied with 403.

title: TERRITORY_MANAGER cannot create a catalog category (catalog_manage required)
rationale: Catalog routes require 'training.catalog_manage', granted only to TRAINING_OPS and SUPER_ADMIN. TERRITORY_MANAGER has 'training.schedule' but not catalog_manage, so this must be 403.

title: Create catalog category missing code and name
rationale: createTrainingCategory normalizes code and trims name; if either is falsy it throws 'code and name are required'. Confirms required-field enforcement.

title: Create catalog category with invalid kind enum
rationale: toTrainingCategoryKind checks the value against the TrainingCategoryKind enum; 'BANANA' is absent and throws 'Unsupported training category kind: banana'.

title: Create training type with defaultDurationMinutes=0
expectMessageContains: defaultdurationminutes must be greater than zero
rationale: createTrainingType throws when defaultDurationMinutes <= 0. Zero is the boundary and must be rejected (after category lookup succeeds).

title: Create training type with invalid deliveryMode enum
rationale: toTrainingDeliveryMode rejects values not in TrainingDeliveryMode enum: throws 'Unsupported training delivery mode: telepathy'.

title: Create training type under a nonexistent category
rationale: createTrainingType looks up the category first and throws 'Training category not found' for a missing id; 'not found' maps to 404 (or 400 as a body-field error).

title: Reschedule a nonexistent/non-scheduled session
rationale: rescheduleTrainingSession resolves the session via requireVisibleTrainingSession, which throws 'Training session not found' (->404) for a nonexistent id; a real non-SCHEDULED session would instead throw 'Only scheduled training sessions can be rescheduled'. Validates the not-found path of the state-guarded endpoint.

title: Reschedule to a past date (future-date guard exists)
rationale: For a real scheduled session, reschedule enforces 'scheduledAt must be in the future'. Against {{nonexistentId}} the session lookup fails first with 'Training session not found' (404), keeping the case standalone and safe; both guards live in the same handler.

title: Complete session without required checkoutNotes
rationale: completeTrainingSession requires checkoutNotes ('checkoutNotes are required when completing a training session') but only AFTER resolving the session. Against {{nonexistentId}} the lookup throws 'Training session not found' (404) first, verifying not-found precedes body validation.

title: Cancel session with an invalid terminal status enum
rationale: cancelTrainingSession only accepts 'cancelled' or 'no_show'; 'completed' would throw 'Unsupported training session terminal status' on a real scheduled session. Against {{nonexistentId}} the session lookup throws 'Training session not found' (404) first — confirming lookup-before-validate ordering and the not-found mapping.

title: Resolve certification decision on a nonexistent session
rationale: resolveTrainingCertificationDecision resolves the session first; a nonexistent id throws 'Training session not found' -> 404. For a real session the state guards 'Only completed...' / 'certification-track' / 'Only pending...' would apply.

title: Resolve certification decision with an invalid outcome
rationale: Decision normalizes outcome and rejects anything but awarded/not_awarded ('certificationOutcome must be awarded or not_awarded') after the session is loaded. Against {{nonexistentId}} the not-found guard fires first (404). Documents the layered validation.

title: Upload proof without a fileName
rationale: uploadTrainingSessionProof loads the session first (throws 'Training session not found' -> 404 for {{nonexistentId}}); on a real session a missing fileName throws 'fileName is required'. Validates not-found precedence on the proof endpoint.

title: Upload proof with a disallowed MIME type
rationale: Proof MIME is whitelisted to pdf/jpeg/png/webp/csv; a real session would throw 'Unsupported training proof file type'. Against {{nonexistentId}} the session lookup throws 'Training session not found' (404) first. Confirms unsafe file types are gated and the endpoint is not-found-safe.

title: SALES_BD_REP cannot upload training proof
rationale: Proof upload requires 'training.schedule', absent from SALES_BD_REP's action set. Authorization must fail with 403 before any session lookup or body validation.

title: Create follow-up task with whitespace-only title
rationale: createTrainingFollowUpTaskInTransaction trims title and throws 'Follow-up task title is required' for whitespace-only; but createTrainingFollowUpTask resolves the session first, so {{nonexistentId}} yields 'Training session not found' (404). Captures the not-found-before-validate behavior.

title: Revoke certification is idempotent; nonexistent id is 404
rationale: revokeTrainingCertification returns the same summary (no error) when status is already REVOKED, proving idempotency. Against {{nonexistentId}} requireVisibleTrainingCertification throws 'Training certification not found' -> 404, validating the lookup. Run twice on a real fixture cert to confirm the second call still returns 200.

title: Create session with durationMinutes as a string
rationale: durationMinutes is typed as number. A string '"sixty"' fails the numeric `<= 0` comparison ambiguously and/or the Prisma Int column write — a correct system returns 400, never 500 or a stored bad value.

title: List sessions with a non-numeric limit query param
rationale: parseInteger returns undefined for non-integer values, so the handler omits limit and falls back to the default take of 100. A bad pagination param must be safely ignored (200), not error.

title: List sessions with an unknown status filter is ignored
rationale: The http handler only accepts status in a fixed whitelist; an unknown value is normalized to null and dropped, defaulting to 'all'. Invalid enum query params are tolerated and return 200, not 400.

title: List sessions with a negative limit
rationale: parseInteger accepts -5 (it is an integer) and passes it as Prisma `take`. Prisma rejects negative take values, so the query layer may surface a 400; otherwise it is coerced. Either way the API must not 500 — this probes unbounded pagination input.

title: DEALER blocked from training overview (no module / or unauth)
rationale: DEALER_PORTAL_USER lacks the 'training' module, so even authenticated it is 403; if credentials are omitted, requireAuthenticatedActor raises an authentication error -> 401. Confirms the overview endpoint is not anonymously or dealer accessible.

title: Create account training program with a template not matching the type
rationale: createAccountTrainingProgram throws 'Training template not found' for a missing templateId, and 'Training template does not belong to the selected training type' when a real template's trainingTypeId mismatches. Validates type/template consistency checks.

title: Wrong HTTP method on the account-sessions route (GET not allowed)
rationale: The /accounts/:id/sessions route only handles POST; any other method returns methodNotAllowedResponse(['POST']) -> 405 with an Allow header. Confirms method gating on a mutation endpoint.

title: Create site with empty accountId rejected
rationale: createConsignmentSite throws 'accountId is required' when input.accountId is falsy. Empty string is falsy so the guard fires before any DB lookup.

title: Create site with well-formed but nonexistent accountId
rationale: prisma.account.findUnique returns null for an unknown id; service throws 'Account not found'. http.ts maps messages containing 'not found' to 404.

title: Create site with PAN in notes rejected
bodyJson: {"accountId":"{{accountId}}","name":"QA PCI Site","notes":"customer card {{PAN}} keep on file"}
rationale: assertNoRawPaymentCardData(input.notes) runs first in createConsignmentSite. A Luhn-valid Visa (4111...) with MII 4 triggers the PCI guard before account lookup, throwing a 'payment card data' message.

title: Create site with SQL/script in name handled safely
rationale: name has no validation beyond cleanOptional trim and is persisted via Prisma parameterized queries. Injection text must be stored verbatim and NOT cause a 500; a correct system returns 201 with the raw string.

title: Create site with 100k-char notes (no length cap)
rationale: There is no explicit notes length validation in createConsignmentSite, only PCI and trim. A correct system either persists it (201) or rejects via a body-size/DB column limit (413), but must not 500.

title: Create site with emoji/unicode contact name
rationale: No charset restriction exists; cleanOptional only trims. Unicode/emoji must round-trip and be stored, returning 201.

title: FINANCE denied creating a consignment site
rationale: FINANCE lacks the 'consignment' module in ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS and has no consignment.* action. assertConsignmentManage -> assertModuleAccess fails -> AuthorizationError -> 403.

title: SALES_BD_REP denied listing consignment sites
rationale: SALES_BD_REP has neither the consignment module nor consignment.view action. assertConsignmentAccess throws AuthorizationError -> 403 even for read.

title: TERRITORY_MANAGER denied managing site (manage action)
rationale: TM has consignment.view and consignment.audit but NOT consignment.manage. createConsignmentSite calls assertConsignmentManage -> assertActionAccess('consignment.manage') fails -> 403.

title: REGIONAL_DIRECTOR denied creating a document (document_manage)
rationale: RD has consignment.view/audit but not consignment.document_manage. upsertConsignmentDocument -> assertConsignmentDocumentManage -> assertActionAccess('consignment.document_manage') fails -> 403.

title: EXECUTIVE denied managing workflow (explicit exec block)
rationale: EXECUTIVE has consignment.view only. startConsignmentExit -> assertConsignmentManage throws 'Executive role can view consignment but cannot manage workflow records' as AuthorizationError -> 403.

title: DEALER denied viewing site detail
rationale: Dealer portal users are blocked: assertConsignmentAccess throws 'Consignment is internal-only in the current phase' for DEALER_PORTAL_USER, and the module isn't granted -> 403 (401 if dealer token isn't accepted on internal API).

title: Get site detail for nonexistent site id returns 404
rationale: getConsignmentSiteDetail returns null for an unknown id (scoped findFirst); http.ts returns notFoundResponse with entity ConsignmentSite.

title: Adjustment with negative currentTotal rejected
rationale: normalizeNonNegativeInteger(currentTotal) truncates then throws 'currentTotal must be a non-negative integer' for negative values.

title: Adjustment with non-finite currentTotal rejected
rationale: 1e999 serializes/parses to Infinity; normalizeNonNegativeInteger checks Number.isFinite and throws 'currentTotal must be a finite number'.

title: Adjustment that does not change baseline rejected
rationale: With add=0, remove=0 and no proposedTotal, createConsignmentAdjustment throws 'PURPLE adjustment must change the manual baseline total'.

title: Adjustment removeQuantity exceeding currentTotal rejected
rationale: removeQuantity (25) > currentTotal (10) triggers the explicit guard 'removeQuantity cannot exceed currentTotal'.

title: Adjustment proposedTotal equal to currentTotal rejected
rationale: When proposedTotal === currentTotal the service throws 'PURPLE adjustment proposedTotal must differ from currentTotal'.

title: Apply a nonexistent adjustment returns not found
rationale: applyConsignmentAdjustment findUnique returns null for unknown id -> throws 'Consignment adjustment not found' -> 404 via 'not found' mapping.

title: Apply adjustment with invalid appliedAt date rejected
rationale: parseRequiredDate('not-a-date','appliedAt') throws 'appliedAt must be a valid ISO date'. (Lookup of the placeholder id may 404 first depending on evaluation order, so 400/404 are both acceptable for a correct system.)

title: Schedule audit without scheduledFor rejected
expectMessageContains: scheduledfor must be a valid iso date
rationale: createConsignmentAudit calls parseRequiredDate(input.scheduledFor,'scheduledFor'); undefined becomes Invalid Date and throws the validation message.

title: Schedule audit with malformed scheduledFor rejected
rationale: An out-of-range date string yields NaN time; parseRequiredDate throws 'scheduledFor must be a valid ISO date'.

title: Schedule audit far in the future accepted
rationale: There is no upper bound on scheduledFor; a valid ISO date in year 4099 parses fine and the audit is created (201), also updating site.nextAuditDueAt.

title: TRAINING_OPS denied scheduling an audit
rationale: TRAINING_OPS lacks the consignment module and consignment.audit action. assertConsignmentAuditManage -> assertModuleAccess('consignment') fails -> 403.

title: True-up on an audit that is not completed rejected
rationale: confirmConsignmentTrueUp scoped findFirst returns null for unknown id -> 'Consignment audit not found' -> 404. (For a real non-completed audit the same endpoint throws 'ROSE audit must be completed before true-up can be confirmed'.)

title: True-up with invalid outcome enum rejected
rationale: toTrueUpOutcome rejects any value not in {po_required,resolved_no_po,write_off} with 'outcome must be po_required, resolved_no_po, or write_off'. (Audit lookup may 404 first for the placeholder id.)

title: Close exit with no return/retained/settlement rejected
rationale: closeConsignmentExit findUnique returns null for unknown id -> 'Consignment exit not found' -> 404. (For a real open exit the same body triggers 'SAND closure needs return quantity, retained quantity, or settlement reference'.)

title: Mark PO received on nonexistent discrepancy returns 404
rationale: markConsignmentPoReceived findUnique returns null for unknown id -> 'Consignment discrepancy not found' -> 404. (For a non-PO-required discrepancy the guard 'Only PO-required discrepancies can be marked received' applies.)

title: Evidence upload missing fileName rejected
rationale: uploadConsignmentAuditEvidence requires fileName; cleanOptional(undefined) is undefined -> throws 'fileName is required'. (Audit scope lookup may 404 first for the placeholder id.)

title: Evidence upload with disallowed mime type rejected
rationale: application/pdf is not in CONSIGNMENT_EVIDENCE_ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES (jpeg/png/webp/heic/heif) -> throws 'ROSE evidence upload accepts photos only'. (May 404 first if audit id resolves before mime check.)

title: Evidence upload exceeding 4MB rejected
rationale: estimateBase64DecodedSize vs CONSIGNMENT_EVIDENCE_MAX_BYTES (4MB) throws 'ROSE evidence photo cannot exceed 4 MB' once past the audit lookup; the 8MB HTTP body limit could also reject very large payloads (413). HUGE is ~100k chars so it passes the body limit but a correct system still rejects if it decodes beyond 4MB at the service layer; placeholder id may 404 first.

title: Activate site without prerequisites blocked
rationale: updateConsignmentSite with status active calls assertSiteCanActivate; a freshly-created QA site lacks signed agreement, BLUE baseline, and warehouse reference, so it throws 'Consignment site cannot become active until signed agreement, BLUE baseline evidence, warehouse reference exist'.

title: Update site with invalid status enum
rationale: toSiteStatus uppercases the string and passes it to Prisma as an enum; 'FROZEN' is not a ConsignmentSiteStatus, so Prisma rejects the update. A robust system surfaces a 400/422 validation error rather than a raw 500 — flag a 500 as an unvalidated-enum gap.

title: Update site notes containing PAN rejected
rationale: updateConsignmentSite calls assertNoRawPaymentCardData(input.notes) before mutation; a Luhn-valid Visa triggers the PCI rejection.

title: Re-closing an already-closed exit is idempotent
rationale: closeConsignmentExit short-circuits when exit.status === CLOSED and returns the site detail (200) without re-mutating. With a placeholder id the lookup 404s; against a real already-closed QA exit a repeat call must return 200 idempotently (no duplicate state change).

title: List sites with non-numeric limit falls back to default
rationale: readIntegerQuery yields NaN/undefined for 'abc'; clampLimit treats NaN as DEFAULT_LIMIT (50). A correct system returns 200 with a default page rather than erroring on a bad query param.

title: List sites with limit above MAX is clamped
rationale: clampLimit caps take at MAX_LIMIT (200); an oversized limit must not error and must not return more than 200 rows. Returns 200.

title: List sites with negative dueWithinDays handled
rationale: dueWithinDays feeds addDays(now,-30) producing a past cutoff (nextAuditDueAt <= pastDate). This is a valid filter that simply matches overdue sites; a correct system returns 200, not an error.

title: Ops queue with invalid auditStatus filter
rationale: readOperationalQueueQuery passes auditStatus through; buildOperationalQueueWhere does input.auditStatus.toUpperCase() as enum into a Prisma 'some' filter. 'BOGUS' is not a ConsignmentAuditStatus — a robust system returns 200 (no matches) or a 400; a raw 500 indicates the bad enum reaches the DB unvalidated.

title: Account read-model for nonexistent account returns 404
rationale: getAccountConsignmentReadModel returns null when prisma.account.findUnique finds no account; http.ts returns notFoundResponse for AccountConsignmentReadModel.

title: Adjustment fractional currentTotal truncated then validated
rationale: normalizeNonNegativeInteger uses Math.trunc, so 5.9->5 and 2.9->2; proposedTotal=7 differs from current 5, so a correct system accepts (201) with truncated integers. Documents off-by-one truncation behavior; a rejection would also be defensible.

title: Document externalRef with script payload stored safely
rationale: externalRef/title have no validation beyond trim and are written via parameterized Prisma queries. Injection/script content must be stored verbatim and returned without executing or 500-ing.

title: Upsert document with invalid formType
rationale: toFormType uppercases 'teal'->'TEAL' and passes it to Prisma create as a ConsignmentFormType enum. 'TEAL' is not valid; a robust system returns 400/422 — a raw 500 signals the enum reaches the DB unvalidated.

title: Audit completion line missing required productName
rationale: completeAudit maps lines into consignmentAuditLine.createMany with productName (required, non-null column) absent. For a real audit this should be a 400; with the placeholder id the audit lookup 404s. A raw 500 indicates productName is not validated before the DB insert.

title: SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP denied consignment dashboard
rationale: SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP has no consignment module/consignment.view. getConsignmentDashboard -> assertConsignmentAccess throws AuthorizationError -> 403.

title: Start a SAND exit on an already-exited site rejected
rationale: startConsignmentExit throws 'Exited consignment sites cannot start another SAND exit' only when the target site.status is already EXITED. For a non-exited QA fixture the call legitimately creates an exit (201); this case documents the illegal-transition guard for an exited site (400/422).

title: Start exit with invalid noticeGivenAt rejected
expectMessageContains: noticegivenat must be a valid iso date
rationale: startConsignmentExit parses noticeGivenAt via parseRequiredDate; 'yesterday' is Invalid Date -> throws 'noticeGivenAt must be a valid ISO date'.

title: Audit notes containing PAN rejected
rationale: createConsignmentAudit calls assertNoRawPaymentCardData(input.notes,'Consignment audit notes') before scheduling; the Luhn-valid Visa triggers the PCI guard.

title: Document version zero/negative coerced to minimum 1
rationale: upsertConsignmentDocument stores version only when input.version>0 else 1 (compact + ternary). version 0 falls back to 1; a correct system returns 201 with version normalized to 1 rather than persisting 0.

title: Apply adjustment with empty body succeeds on requested adjustment
rationale: ApplyConsignmentAdjustmentRequest has only optional fields (appliedAt, notes); an empty body is valid and defaults appliedAt to now. With the placeholder id the adjustment lookup returns null -> 'Consignment adjustment not found' -> 404. Confirms empty-body handling and not-found path together.

title: TERRITORY_MANAGER denied CIS module on send-link (no cis module access)
rationale: ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS gives TERRITORY_MANAGER no 'cis' module, and issueCisLink calls assertModuleAccess(role,'cis') which throws AuthorizationError -> 403. Proves the module gate, not just the action gate.

title: SALES_BD_REP denied finance-decision (lacks lead.finance_decide)
rationale: recordFinanceDecision asserts lead.finance_decide, granted only to FINANCE and SUPER_ADMIN. SALES_BD_REP has cis module but not finance_decide, so assertActionAccess throws before any package lookup -> 403 (must precede the would-be 404).

title: FINANCE denied submit-to-finance (lacks lead.intake_manage)
rationale: submitCisToFinance asserts lead.intake_manage; FINANCE role action list excludes intake_manage (it only has finance_queue_view + finance_decide). assertActionAccess throws AuthorizationError -> 403.

title: EXECUTIVE denied finance-decision (read-only oversight role)
rationale: EXECUTIVE was hardened to view-only: its action list has lead.finance_queue_view but NOT lead.finance_decide. recordFinanceDecision's assertActionAccess(lead.finance_decide) throws -> 403.

title: SALES_BD_REP denied finance-queue view (lacks finance_queue_view)
rationale: listFinanceQueue asserts lead.finance_queue_view; SALES_BD_REP action list excludes it (only SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP/FINANCE/EXECUTIVE/SUPER_ADMIN have it). assertActionAccess throws -> 403.

title: DEALER denied public-internal CIS package GET (no cis module)
rationale: getCisPackageDetail asserts module 'cis' then action lead.view. DEALER (DEALER_PORTAL_USER) has neither cis module nor lead.view; assertModuleAccess throws AuthorizationError -> 403, taking precedence over the 404 the nonexistent id would otherwise yield.

title: send-link blocked before discovery completed (discovery gate)
rationale: issueCisLink throws 'CIS cannot be issued until discovery is completed for this lead' when lead.stage is not in CIS_SENDABLE_LEAD_STAGES (DISCOVERY_COMPLETED+). For a fixture lead still in an early stage the gate fires -> 400. If the fixture lead is already past discovery the call may succeed, so harness should seed a pre-discovery lead; 404 only if the lead is out of the actor's scope.

title: send-link on nonexistent lead id returns not found
rationale: issueCisLink's tx throws `Lead not found: <id>` for a well-formed-but-absent lead id; the http catch maps messages containing 'not found' to notFoundResponse -> 404.

title: PAN in send-link note rejected (PCI boundary on CIS note)
rationale: issueCisLink calls assertNoRawPaymentCardData(note,'CIS note'); the Luhn+MII guard matches the test Visa 4111111111111111 and throws a message ending 'appears to contain payment card data...'. http catch -> 400. Confirms PCI rejection precedes (or replaces) the discovery gate ordering.

title: PAN with dash separators in finance decision notes rejected
rationale: recordFinanceDecision runs after the package lookup; assertNoRawPaymentCardData on decisionNotes catches the dash-separated PAN (PAN_CANDIDATE allows single hyphen separators) -> 400 'payment card data'. With {{nonexistentId}} the not-found check fires first (404); harness should also target a real finance-pending fixture to force the 400 path.

title: PAN typed into public CIS form free-text field rejected on save-draft
rationale: savePublicCisDraft calls assertNoRawPaymentCardDataInRecord(mergedForm) which scans every string field one level deep; a PAN in any field (not just card-named) throws 'payment card data'. Public route is token-based; {{nonexistentId}} as token yields 404 'not found or expired' first, so harness should substitute a live link token to reach the 400 path.

title: PAN obfuscated with zero-width spaces still rejected (invisible-char stripping)
rationale: containsLikelyPaymentCardNumber strips INVISIBLE_FORMATTING (U+200B etc.) before matching, so a zero-width-space-obfuscated Visa is still detected and assertNoRawPaymentCardData throws 'payment card data'. {{nonexistentId}} forces 404 first; a real signed-off fixture forces the 400. Proves the unicode evasion guard.

title: finance approve without card-on-file authorization rejected
rationale: validateFinanceDecisionInput throws 'Card-on-file authorization is required before approving finance' when formData.cardOnFileAuthorized is falsy on an approval. Requires the fixture package to be finance-pending without card auth; if {{cisPackageId}} isn't finance-pending the state-machine 400 ('not in a finance-review state') or 404 (scope) applies instead.

title: finance approve non-card terms missing creditLineAmount rejected
rationale: When paymentMethod != CREDIT_CARD and decision=approved, validateFinanceDecisionInput throws 'creditLineAmount is required when approving non-card payment terms'. Needs a card-authorized, finance-pending, non-credit-card fixture; otherwise upstream 400/404 applies.

title: finance approve non-card terms missing paymentTerms rejected
rationale: Symmetric to the prior rule: validateFinanceDecisionInput throws 'paymentTerms is required when approving non-card payment terms' for an approved non-card decision lacking paymentTerms.

title: finance approve with zero creditLineAmount rejected (must be > 0)
rationale: normalizeCreditLineAmount throws 'creditLineAmount must be greater than zero' when value <= 0 (0 is the boundary). Reaches this only after validateFinanceDecisionInput passes (card auth present); else 400/404 upstream.

title: finance approve with negative creditLineAmount rejected
rationale: normalizeCreditLineAmount rejects value <= 0 (Number.isFinite && >0 required), so -100 throws 'creditLineAmount must be greater than zero'. Boundary just below zero.

title: finance decline without decisionNotes rejected
rationale: validateFinanceDecisionInput throws 'decisionNotes is required when declining finance' when decision=declined and decisionNotes is blank/absent. Requires a finance-review-state fixture; else 404/400 upstream.

title: finance conditional outcome without any notes rejected
rationale: For decision in {conditional, info_requested} with neither decisionNotes nor requestedInfoNotes, validateFinanceDecisionInput throws 'decisionNotes or requestedInfoNotes is required for conditional or info-requested outcomes'.

title: finance-decision with invalid decision value rejected
rationale: 'maybe' is not in the decision enum (info_requested|approved|conditional|declined). validateFinanceDecisionInput's branches don't match it, then mapFinanceDecisionState hits its default and throws 'Unsupported finance decision: maybe' -> 400. (404 only if {{cisPackageId}} resolves out of scope / not in finance state.)

title: finance-decision on a package not in finance-review state rejected
rationale: recordFinanceDecision requires status in {FINANCE_PENDING, FINANCE_APPROVED, FINANCE_DECLINED}; a freshly-created LINK_SENT/SUBMITTED fixture throws 'CIS package is not in a finance-review state' -> 400. 404 if the fixture id is out of the actor's lead scope.

title: submit-to-finance before sales sign-off rejected
rationale: submitCisToFinance requires status SALES_SIGNED_OFF or FINANCE_PENDING; a not-yet-signed-off fixture (e.g. LINK_SENT/SUBMITTED) throws 'CIS package must be Sales/BD signed off before finance submission' -> 400. 404 if out of scope.

title: submit-to-finance without card-on-file authorization rejected
