rationale: After the state check, submitCisToFinance throws 'Card-on-file authorization is required before finance submission' when formData.cardOnFileAuthorized is falsy. Requires a SALES_SIGNED_OFF fixture whose form lacks card auth; else upstream 400/404.

title: review-signoff on a package not in a reviewable state rejected
rationale: reviewAndSignOffCis requires status SUBMITTED, REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS, or SALES_SIGNED_OFF; a LINK_SENT/DRAFT_IN_PROGRESS fixture throws 'CIS package is not ready for Sales/BD sign-off' -> 400. 404 if out of scope.

title: finance-decision on nonexistent package returns not found
rationale: buildScopedCisPackageWhere finds nothing for a well-formed-but-absent id, throwing 'CIS package not found: <id>'; http catch maps 'not found' -> 404. FINANCE passes RBAC so this isolates the not-found path.

title: public CIS package GET with bogus token returns not found/expired
rationale: Public route is token-based (no auth). getPublicCisPackage hashes the token and findFirst returns null for an unknown hash; http returns notFoundResponse 'CIS link not found or expired' -> 404. Confirms token enumeration yields 404 not 500.

title: upload-scan with empty fileName rejected (required, trimmed)
rationale: uploadLeadCisScan calls requireTrimmed(input.fileName,'fileName'); a whitespace-only value trims to empty and throws 'fileName is required' before the lead lookup -> 400. Boundary: blank-but-present required string.

title: public submit missing required contact/company fields rejected
rationale: submitPublicCis runs validateSubmissionForm which throws '<label> is required' for the first missing required string (e.g. primaryContactEmail/legalCompanyName/physicalAddress...). With a live link token the merged form lacks required fields -> 400; {{nonexistentId}} as token yields 404 'not found or expired' first.

title: public save-draft with malformed primaryContactEmail rejected on submit
rationale: validateSubmissionForm checks looksLikeEmail(primaryContactEmail); 'not-an-email' fails the regex -> throws 'primaryContactEmail must be a valid email'. All other required fields are supplied so this isolates the email-format rule (reachable with a live token; 404 with bogus token).

title: public form monthsInBusiness above max (11) rejected
rationale: validateSubmissionForm enforces 0..11 for monthsInBusiness; 12 is one past the max and throws 'monthsInBusiness must be between 0 and 11'. Off-by-one upper boundary. (404 only if the link token is bogus.)

title: public form negative numOfTechs rejected (integer >= 0)
rationale: mergeFormData -> assignOptionalInteger parses numOfTechs and throws 'numOfTechs must be an integer zero or greater' when parsed < 0. -1 is the boundary just below zero; this fires during draft merge before persistence. (404 with bogus token.)

title: public form non-integer numOfTechs rejected
rationale: assignOptionalInteger does Number('abc') -> NaN, and !Number.isInteger(NaN) throws 'numOfInstallTechs must be an integer zero or greater'. Confirms non-numeric strings are rejected rather than silently coerced. (404 with bogus token.)

title: public form invalid paymentMethod enum rejected
rationale: assignOptionalPaymentMethod allows only NET_30, ACH, CREDIT_CARD; 'BITCOIN' throws 'paymentMethod must be NET_30, ACH, or CREDIT_CARD' during mergeFormData. (404 with bogus token.)

title: SQL injection in legalCompanyName handled safely (no 500)
rationale: legalCompanyName is a plain string assigned via assignOptionalString and persisted through Prisma parameterized queries; the SQL metacharacters are stored verbatim, not executed. With a live link token in editable state this returns 200; a bogus token yields 404. The correctness signal is the absence of a 500 and no DB damage.

title: Script/XSS payload in submission note stored safely (no 500)
rationale: submissionNotes passes assertNoRawPaymentCardData (no PAN) and is stored as a plain string; the script tag is not executed server-side. Returns 200 for a SALES_SIGNED_OFF card-authorized fixture, 400 if the package isn't in a submittable state, or 404 if out of scope. Proves safe handling, never a 500.

title: Emoji/unicode in salesReviewNotes accepted without error
rationale: salesReviewNotes is trimmed and PCI-scanned only; multibyte unicode/emoji are not PANs so it stores cleanly. 200 for a reviewable fixture; 400 if not in a reviewable state; 404 if out of scope. Confirms unicode free text doesn't break persistence.

title: Oversize submissionNotes handled without server crash
rationale: A 10k-char note has no explicit length cap in submitCisToFinance (only PCI scan + trim), so it should either persist (200 for a valid signed-off fixture) or be refused by the state check (400) / scope (404) / a body-size guard (413) — but never 500. Verifies large free text degrades gracefully.

title: Repeated send-link (resend) increments rather than erroring
rationale: issueCisLink reuses an existing active editable DIGITAL_LINK package (status LINK_SENT/DRAFT) and increments externalLinkSentCount, emitting a link_resent event — so repeating the mutation is safe and idempotent-by-design (200) for a post-discovery lead. 400 if the lead is pre-discovery; 404 if out of scope. Confirms no duplicate-key/500 on repeat.

title: Repeated finance decline is accepted (re-decision allowed in finance state)
rationale: recordFinanceDecision permits status in {FINANCE_PENDING, FINANCE_APPROVED, FINANCE_DECLINED} and upserts the decision, so deciding an already-FINANCE_DECLINED package again re-writes the same decision (200) rather than erroring. 400 only if the fixture is pre-finance; 404 if out of scope. Verifies decision idempotency.

title: finance-queue with unknown decisionStatus query returns full queue (no validation)
rationale: listFinanceQueue does NOT validate decisionStatus: an unrecognized value falls through the if/else to the default branch (status in SALES_SIGNED_OFF..FINANCE_DECLINED) and then the post-map filter compares item.financeDecisionStatus === 'bogus_value' (always false), yielding an empty list with total 0. A correct system returns 200 here, not 400 — grounds that this param is non-strict.

title: TRAINING_OPS denied lead CIS package GET (no cis module, no lead.view)
rationale: getLeadCisPackage asserts module 'cis' then action lead.view. TRAINING_OPS has neither (its modules are training-centric and its actions are catalog/asset only), so assertModuleAccess throws AuthorizationError -> 403.

title: apply parsed-draft with nonexistent draft id returns not found
rationale: applyCisParsedDraft loads the package (scoped) then findFirst the draft by {id: draftId, cisPackageId}; an absent draft id throws 'CIS parsed draft not found: <id>' -> 404. Uses a real {{cisPackageId}} so the package resolves and the draft-not-found path is isolated.

title: public submit missing cardOnFileAuthorized rejected (must be true)
rationale: validateSubmissionForm requires cardOnFileAuthorized === true (strict), throwing 'cardOnFileAuthorized is required' when absent/false even though card capture is descoped — the authorization flag itself is still mandatory at submit. Reachable with a live link token; 404 with bogus token.

title: public submit without signature rejected
rationale: validateSubmissionForm throws 'Signature is required' when signatureCapturedAt is unset (hasSignature not sent, so mergeFormData leaves it null). Confirms the e-sign gate at submit. Reachable with a live link token; 404 with bogus token.

title: save-draft on a non-editable (already submitted) package rejected
rationale: savePublicCisDraft requires status in ACTIVE_EDITABLE_CIS_STATUSES (NOT_SENT, LINK_SENT, DRAFT_IN_PROGRESS); a SUBMITTED/finance-stage package throws 'CIS package can no longer be edited' -> 400. Needs a live token pointing at a non-editable package; a bogus/expired token yields 404 'not found or expired'.

title: Re-applying an already-applied parsed draft re-merges without error
rationale: applyCisParsedDraft re-merges the draft's safeFieldPayload and sets the draft to PARSED again; there is no guard against re-apply, so repeating is non-destructive (200) when the draft has safe fields. 400 'does not contain any safe fields' if the draft payload is empty; 404 if package/draft id doesn't resolve. ({{definitionId}} is a stand-in draft id the harness maps to a real parsed-draft fixture.)

title: DEALER denied reports module on list definitions
rationale: listReportDefinitions calls assertModuleAccess(role,'reports'). DEALER_PORTAL_USER has only dealer.* actions and no 'reports' module access, so the AuthorizationError surfaces as 403. Proves the reports surface is fully denied to dealers.

title: TRAINING_OPS denied executive dashboard
rationale: getExecutiveDashboard requires assertActionAccess(role,'reports.executive'). Only EXECUTIVE and SUPER_ADMIN hold reports.executive; TRAINING_OPS has reports module but not the executive action, so AuthorizationError -> 403. Guards the org-wide exec KPIs.

title: SALES_BD_REP denied executive dashboard
rationale: reports.executive is granted only to EXECUTIVE/SUPER_ADMIN. SALES_BD_REP has reports.builder but not reports.executive, so getExecutiveDashboard throws AuthorizationError -> 403. Confirms a non-oversight role cannot read org-wide exec numbers.

title: EXECUTIVE allowed executive dashboard (positive control)
rationale: EXECUTIVE holds both 'reports' module and reports.executive action, so getExecutiveDashboard passes both guards and returns the ExecutiveDashboardResponse. Positive control proving the gate admits the intended role.

title: TRAINING_OPS denied lead dashboard (lacks lead.view)
rationale: getLeadDashboard requires assertActionAccess(role,'lead.view') after the reports module gate. TRAINING_OPS is a training-only role without lead.view, so it is denied lead KPIs even though it can reach the reports module -> 403.

title: FINANCE denied training dashboard (no training module)
rationale: getTrainingDashboard requires assertModuleAccess(role,'training') in addition to reports. FINANCE has reports module but not the training module, so AuthorizationError -> 403. Proves a reports-but-not-training role cannot read training data here.

title: TRAINING_OPS denied stale-accounts (lacks customer.view)
rationale: getStaleAccountsReport requires assertActionAccess(role,'customer.view'). TRAINING_OPS has reports module but not customer.view, so the account-engagement report is denied -> 403.

title: FINANCE denied threshold-settings PUT (no admin.integration_manage)
rationale: The PUT route uses withReportingAdminAuth (admin.integration_manage) and updateReportingThresholdSettings re-asserts assertActionAccess(role,'admin.integration_manage'). FINANCE lacks that action, so the system-config change is denied -> 403.

title: EXECUTIVE denied threshold-settings PUT (read-only oversight role)
rationale: EXECUTIVE is a hardened read-only oversight role lacking admin.integration_manage. Even though it can GET threshold-settings, the PUT mutation is gated on the admin action and must be denied -> 403.

title: Ad-hoc run with unknown reportKey
rationale: runAdHocReport -> assertReportKey rejects any key not in REPORT_KEYS (lead_funnel/training_compliance/consignment_audit_status/territory_coverage/field_activity). 'revenue_by_region' is invalid (revenue is Acumatica-parked), so a plain Error -> 400.

title: Ad-hoc run with missing reportKey
rationale: runAdHocReport receives body.reportKey=undefined; assertReportKey checks membership in REPORT_KEYS and throws 'Unknown report key: undefined' -> 400. Confirms the required discriminator is validated, not defaulted.

title: Ad-hoc lead_funnel with inverted date window (end before start)
rationale: reportWindow builds start/end directly from the ISO strings with no ordering check; an inverted window yields an empty (gte start, lte end) result. A correct system returns 200 with rowCount 0 rather than erroring on the nonsensical range.

title: Ad-hoc field_activity with malformed startDate string
rationale: reportWindow does new Date('not-a-dateT00:00:00.000Z') producing an Invalid Date. Prisma comparisons against an Invalid Date either yield empty results (200) or raise a query error caught as 400. Either is acceptable; a 500 unhandled crash would be the defect.

title: Ad-hoc lead_funnel with far-future window (year 9999)
rationale: A valid but far-future window is parseable by reportWindow; the createdAt>=start filter simply matches no leads. Correct behaviour is 200 with an empty result and the 25,000 safety cap unbreached.

title: Run saved definition with nonexistent id
rationale: runReportDefinition does findFirst({id, ...visibleWhere}) and throws 'Report definition not found' for a well-formed but absent UUID. The reports handler maps generic Errors to badRequestResponse (400); a stricter system would use 404 — message check confirms the right rejection.

title: PATCH definition with nonexistent id
rationale: updateReportDefinition -> getOwnedDefinition does findUnique by id and throws 'Report definition not found' when absent. Handler maps the plain Error to 400; 404 acceptable for a stricter system. Message check confirms it is the not-found path, not an incidental error.

title: Malformed (non-UUID) definition id on run
rationale: The path id is not a valid UUID. Prisma's findFirst on a uuid column rejects the malformed value, which the handler catches as badRequestResponse (400); a router that 404s the bad id is also acceptable. A 500 would indicate an unhandled query error.

title: Create definition with blank/whitespace name
rationale: createReportDefinition does input.name?.trim() and throws 'Report name is required' when the trimmed value is empty. A whitespace-only name must be rejected, not silently stored -> 400.

title: Create definition with invalid visibility
rationale: createReportDefinition validates visibility against REPORT_VISIBILITIES (private/team/org). 'public' is not a member, so it throws 'Unknown visibility: public' -> 400, preventing an unmapped enum reaching the Prisma enum column.

title: Create definition with invalid reportKey
rationale: createReportDefinition -> assertReportKey rejects keys outside REPORT_KEYS. 'orders_export' is not a CRM-native report key, so a plain Error 'Unknown report key' -> 400 before any DB write.

title: Create definition with SQL injection in name (safe handling)
rationale: Name is persisted via Prisma parameterized create (no string concatenation), so a SQL payload is stored verbatim as data, not executed. Correct behaviour is 201 with the literal string; a 500 or any DB error would indicate an injection-handling defect.

title: Create definition with script payload in description (XSS-safe storage)
rationale: description is trimmed and stored as plain text via Prisma; the API neither executes nor must 500 on a script payload. Correct behaviour is 201 with the raw string preserved (escaping is the UI's responsibility).

title: Create definition with unicode/emoji name
rationale: name only requires a non-empty trimmed string; multibyte/emoji content is valid and stored on a UTF-8 text column. Correct behaviour is 201 with the name round-tripped intact, proving no ASCII-only assumption.

title: Create definition with oversize name
rationale: The service enforces no explicit max length on name, so a 10k-char value is either accepted (201) or rejected by a DB column limit / body-size guard (400/413). Any of those is correct; an unhandled 500 from an overflowed column would be the defect.

title: Non-owner non-admin cannot delete another user's definition
rationale: deleteReportDefinition -> getOwnedDefinition enforces canManage (owner OR SUPER_ADMIN/EXECUTIVE). For a fixture owned by another user, a SALES_BD_REP fails canManage with a plain Error -> the reports handler maps it to 400 (not an AuthorizationError, so not 403, though a stricter system would use 403). Message check confirms the ownership block, not a missing record.

title: Create schedule with hourUtc above range (24)
rationale: assertScheduleInput requires hourUtc be an integer 0..23. 24 is one past the max, so it throws 'hourUtc must be an integer between 0 and 23' -> 400. Off-by-one upper-bound check. Target a QA-owned fixture definition.

title: Create schedule with negative hourUtc (-1)
rationale: assertScheduleInput rejects hourUtc < 0. -1 is the lower off-by-one boundary, throwing 'hourUtc must be an integer between 0 and 23' -> 400.

title: Create schedule with non-integer hourUtc (12.5)
rationale: assertScheduleInput uses Number.isInteger(hourUtc); a fractional 12.5 fails the integer check and throws 'hourUtc must be an integer between 0 and 23' -> 400, even though it is within 0..23.

title: Create schedule with empty recipients array
rationale: assertScheduleInput requires recipients be a non-empty array, throwing 'At least one recipient is required' for [] -> 400. Prevents creating a schedule that would email nobody.
expectMessageContains: at least one recipient is required

title: Create schedule with malformed recipient email
rationale: assertScheduleInput validates each recipient against the email regex ^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$. 'not-an-email' lacks an @ and domain, throwing 'Invalid recipient email: not-an-email' -> 400.

title: Create schedule with invalid cadence
rationale: assertScheduleInput checks cadence membership in REPORT_SCHEDULE_CADENCES (daily/weekly/monthly). 'hourly' is not supported, throwing 'Unknown cadence: hourly' -> 400.

title: Create schedule with hourUtc at min boundary (0) succeeds
rationale: hourUtc=0 is the inclusive lower bound accepted by assertScheduleInput (0..23). With a valid cadence and one valid recipient on a QA-owned definition, createReportSchedule returns 201. Positive boundary control proving 0 is allowed (not treated as falsy/invalid).

title: Create schedule with PAN embedded in recipient address
rationale: A raw 16-digit PAN (4111111111111111) is not a valid email, so the recipient regex in assertScheduleInput rejects it with 'Invalid recipient email' -> 400. This keeps card numbers out of the recipients store; the email-format gate is the effective guard here.

title: List schedules for nonexistent definition
rationale: listReportSchedules does findFirst({id, ...visibleWhere}) and throws 'Report definition not found' when absent or not visible. Handler maps the plain Error to 400; 404 acceptable for a stricter system. Message check distinguishes not-found from other failures.

title: PATCH schedule with nonexistent id
rationale: updateReportSchedule does findUnique by id and throws 'Report schedule not found' for an absent UUID before any canManage/validation. Handler maps to 400; 404 acceptable. Confirms missing-record handling on the schedule sub-resource.

title: Threshold PUT with zero window (below minimum)
rationale: updateReportingThresholdSettings -> normalizeActiveAccountWindowDays rejects value<1, throwing 'activeAccountWindowDays must be a positive number of days'. 0 is below the inclusive minimum of 1 -> 400. Run as SUPER_ADMIN so the admin gate passes and only the value validation is exercised.

title: Threshold PUT with negative window
rationale: normalizeActiveAccountWindowDays throws on value<1; -30 is negative and rejected with 'activeAccountWindowDays must be a positive number of days' -> 400. Run as SUPER_ADMIN to bypass the RBAC gate and isolate numeric validation.

title: Threshold PUT with oversize window is silently capped at 3650
rationale: normalizeActiveAccountWindowDays accepts any finite value>=1 then applies Math.min(floor(value), MAX_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT_WINDOW_DAYS=3650). A million days is not an error; correct behaviour is 200 with settings.activeAccountWindowDays clamped to 3650. Proves the cap is silent, not a rejection.

title: Threshold PUT with non-numeric window value
rationale: normalizeActiveAccountWindowDays runs Number.isFinite(value); the string 'sixty' is not finite, so it throws 'activeAccountWindowDays must be a positive number of days' -> 400. Guards against a non-number reaching the stored flag metadata.

title: Threshold PUT repeated with same value is idempotent
rationale: updateReportingThresholdSettings upserts the reporting.thresholds FeatureFlag, so repeating the identical PUT converges to the same stored value and returns 200 with settings.activeAccountWindowDays=180 each time. Confirms the mutation is safely repeatable (no duplicate-row or unique-constraint error).

title: Update definition to empty name is rejected
rationale: updateReportDefinition only validates name when provided: input.name.trim() yielding '' throws 'Report name cannot be empty' -> 400. Confirms a clear of the required name on a QA-owned definition is blocked while leaving other fields untouched.

title: Update definition with invalid visibility
rationale: updateReportDefinition re-validates visibility against REPORT_VISIBILITIES when provided. 'global' is not private/team/org, throwing 'Unknown visibility: global' -> 400, mirroring the create-path enum guard on a QA-owned fixture.

title: Wrong method on ad-hoc run endpoint (GET -> 405)
rationale: The /reports/run route only handles POST and returns methodNotAllowedResponse(['POST']) for any other verb. A GET must yield 405 with an Allow set, not a 404 or 200, proving the route's method whitelist.

title: Wrong method on lead dashboard (POST -> 405)
rationale: The /reports/dashboard/leads route only handles GET and returns methodNotAllowedResponse(['GET']) otherwise. A POST must be 405, confirming the read-only dashboard cannot be invoked as a mutation.

title: Unknown query params on list definitions are ignored
rationale: listReportDefinitions takes no query parameters — there is no pagination, limit/offset, or export-format handling in the route or service. Bogus query params (negative limit, non-numeric offset, csv format) are simply ignored, so a correct system returns the full 200 ListReportDefinitionsResponse rather than erroring.

title: Routing-rules list denied for SALES_BD_REP (no admin module)
rationale: http.ts gates GET/POST routing-rules on requireAuthenticatedActor(req,{module:'admin'}). SALES_BD_REP is NOT in ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS for 'admin' (auth.ts L334), so assertModuleAccess throws AuthorizationError -> forbiddenResponse 403. Proves the admin gate is enforced on reads, not just writes.

title: Routing-rule create denied for FINANCE
rationale: FINANCE module access (auth.ts L336) excludes 'admin'. The admin gate runs BEFORE body validation, so even a well-formed body must 403 — confirms authz precedes validation and no rule is created.

title: Routing-rule delete denied for REGIONAL_DIRECTOR
rationale: DELETE routing-rules/:id calls requireAuthenticatedActor(req,{module:'admin'}) (http.ts L100). REGIONAL_DIRECTOR lacks 'admin' (auth.ts L339) so 403 — and crucially the gate fires before deleteNotificationRoutingRule, so no fixture is deleted (safe).

title: Unread-count requires a bearer token
rationale: GET /unread-count is per-user (no module gate, http.ts L57). A valid token for any role returns 200 {unreadCount}. Baseline that the inbox is open to every signed-in user, contrasting the admin-gated routing routes.

title: Preferences PUT with missing category is rejected
rationale: http.ts L68 rejects when !body.category. No category -> badRequestResponse 'A valid notification category is required.' Confirms required-field enforcement on the preference upsert.

title: Preferences PUT with invalid category enum is rejected
rationale: USER_NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES is exactly [lead,consignment,training,order,account,system]. 'invoices' is not included so http.ts L68 returns 400 before any DB write. Guards the CATEGORY_TO_DB lookup from an undefined key.

title: Preferences PUT with category as a number is rejected
rationale: includes() on the readonly string[] will not match the number 123, so http.ts L68 rejects with 400 — a non-string category must not slip through to CATEGORY_TO_DB.

title: Preferences PUT (disable lead) is idempotent on repeat
rationale: updateNotificationPreference uses prisma.upsert on (recipientUserId,category) (service.ts L222). Running the same PUT twice must return 200 with the same preferences list and never duplicate a row — proves the unique-key upsert.

title: Preferences PUT coerces non-boolean inAppEnabled via Boolean()
rationale: http.ts L71 passes Boolean(body.inAppEnabled); a non-empty string coerces to true with NO validation error. Documents the lenient coercion contract — string 'yes' is accepted (200) and stored as enabled=true, not rejected.

title: Routing-rule create missing category is rejected
rationale: http.ts L84 rejects when category missing/invalid before creating. SUPER_ADMIN passes the admin gate, so this isolates the category validation (400) on the create path.

title: Routing-rule create with invalid recipientType is rejected
rationale: NOTIFICATION_ROUTING_RECIPIENT_TYPES is exactly [role,user]. http.ts L87 rejects 'group' with 'recipientType must be "role" or "user".' before RECIPIENT_TYPE_TO_DB lookup.

title: Routing-rule role rule without recipientRoleCode is rejected
expectMessageContains: recipientrolecode is required for a role rule
rationale: service.ts L288 throws 'A recipientRoleCode is required for a role rule.' when recipientType=='role' and recipientRoleCode is empty/missing; the http catch maps the Error to badRequestResponse 400. Cross-field business rule.

title: Routing-rule user rule without recipientUserId is rejected
expectMessageContains: recipientuserid is required for a user rule
rationale: service.ts L291 throws 'A recipientUserId is required for a user rule.' for an empty recipientUserId on a user rule -> 400. Mirror of the role-rule cross-field check.

title: Routing-rule role rule with whitespace-only recipientRoleCode is rejected
expectMessageContains: recipientrolecode is required for a role rule
rationale: service.ts L288 uses recipientRoleCode?.trim() truthiness; a spaces-only string trims to '' (falsy) so it must be rejected (400), not stored as a blank role code.

title: Routing-rule create with valid role rule succeeds (happy boundary)
rationale: A fully valid role rule passes both http.ts validations and service cross-field checks -> create -> jsonResponse 201 with the summary. Establishes the positive boundary; this fixture id is reused by the duplicate/idempotency delete tests.

title: Routing-rule note with SQL injection is stored safely, not 500
rationale: note has no validation and is written via Prisma parameterized create (service.ts L301). Injection text must be persisted verbatim as data and return 201 — a 500 or any DB error would indicate unsafe query construction.

title: Routing-rule note with script/XSS payload is stored as inert text
rationale: The API stores raw note text (no sanitization on input is expected at this layer) and returns 201. Confirms the script is treated as opaque data (no server-side execution / no 500); output encoding is the client's responsibility.

title: Routing-rule note with emoji/unicode is accepted
rationale: note is a free Prisma String with no charset restriction. Multibyte/emoji must round-trip and return 201 — proves UTF-8 handling end-to-end without truncation or 500.

title: Routing-rule note containing a PAN must be rejected (PCI gap)
rationale: A correct PCI-aware system must reject a primary account number in any free-text field. NOTE: the current notifications path has NO PCI/PAN guard (no luhn/card check in http.ts or service.ts), so this case will surface the gap — the harness should flag that the live API stores the PAN and returns 201 instead of rejecting.

title: Routing-rule note with a 100k-char value within body limit
rationale: note has no max-length check and 100k chars stays under readJsonBody's 1,000,000-byte cap (utils/http.ts L93). The system must accept and store it (201) — there is no field-level truncation, documenting the unbounded-text behavior.

title: Delete a non-existent routing rule returns 404
rationale: deleteNotificationRoutingRule does deleteMany and returns count>0 (service.ts L307); a well-formed but absent UUID yields count 0 -> http.ts L107 notFoundResponse 404. SUPER_ADMIN passes the admin gate so this isolates the not-found path.

title: Deleting the same routing rule twice: second delete 404
rationale: After the first successful delete, the row is gone; a repeat delete of the same id has deleteMany count 0 -> 404. Confirms delete is not silently idempotent-200 and only targets a QA fixture id (safe).

title: mark-read with empty body marks nothing (updated 0)
rationale: markNotificationsRead with no ids and all!=true short-circuits to {updated:0, unreadCount} (service.ts L118-120). An empty mark-read must be a safe 200 no-op, never an error and never marking everything.

title: mark-read with all=true is idempotent on repeat
rationale: all=true sets where {readAt:null} then updateMany. Run twice: the second call matches zero remaining unread, returning updated:0 and unreadCount:0 (service.ts L125-127). Proves the bulk mark-read is convergent/idempotent.

title: mark-read with a non-existent id silently matches nothing
rationale: where.id={in:[id]} combined with recipientUserId scoping; a foreign/absent id matches no row so updateMany count is 0 -> 200 {updated:0}. mark-read intentionally does NOT 404 on unknown ids (batch semantics).

title: mark-read ignores empty-string and non-string ids
rationale: service.ts L117 filters ids to typeof==='string' && length>0; all entries are dropped, leaving an empty list -> early return {updated:0} (200). Confirms defensive id filtering rather than a 500 on bad array elements.

title: mark-read with no body at all is a safe no-op
rationale: readJsonBody returns {} for an empty body (utils/http.ts L95), and markNotificationsRead defaults input to {} -> updated:0 path. POST mark-read with no payload must be 200, not 400, for any authed role.

title: Archive a non-existent notification returns 404
rationale: archiveNotification findFirst is scoped to {id, recipientUserId}; an absent id returns null -> http.ts L133 notFoundResponse({entity:'UserNotification'}) 404. Verifies per-actor scoping doubles as the not-found guard.

title: Archiving another user's notification is indistinguishable from not-found
rationale: service.ts L135 filters by recipientUserId===actor.userId, so a notification owned by someone else never resolves for this actor and returns 404 (not 403, to avoid leaking existence). Cross-tenant isolation check using a non-owned id placeholder.

title: GET notifications with status=pending is ignored, defaults to all (200)
rationale: http.ts L145 only accepts status in {unread,archived,all}; any other value is dropped and the service defaults status to 'all' (service.ts L87). An unknown status must NOT 400 — it returns the default list (200), documenting lenient query handling.

title: GET notifications with negative limit/offset is clamped, not rejected
rationale: Number(-5) is an integer so it is applied, then service clamps limit to max(.,1)->min(.,100) and offset to max(.,0) (service.ts L85-86). Negative paging is silently corrected and returns 200 — never a 400 and never a negative skip.

title: GET notifications with oversize limit is capped at 100
rationale: limit=100000 is an integer, applied, then Math.min(.,MAX_LIMIT=100) caps the page size (service.ts L22,L85). Response items length must be <=100 and status 200 — guards against unbounded result sets.

title: GET notifications with non-integer limit (3.7) is ignored
rationale: http.ts L153 only sets query.limit when Number.isInteger(limit); Number('3.7')=3.7 fails the check so the param is dropped and DEFAULT_LIMIT=30 applies. Fractional limits are ignored gracefully (200), not errored.

title: GET notifications with bogus category filter is ignored (200)
rationale: http.ts L149 only applies category when it is in USER_NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES; 'invoices' is dropped, so no filter is applied and the full list returns 200. Confirms an invalid category never reaches CATEGORY_TO_DB and never 400s.

title: Unsupported method on unread-count returns 405
rationale: http.ts L54 only allows GET on /unread-count; POST hits methodNotAllowedResponse(res,method,['GET']) -> 405. Verifies the method allow-list is enforced per route.

title: Unsupported method DELETE on preferences returns 405
rationale: Preferences supports only GET and PUT (http.ts L73); DELETE falls through to methodNotAllowedResponse(['GET','PUT']) -> 405. Confirms preference rows cannot be removed via an undefined verb.

title: Routing-rule POST with malformed JSON body returns 400
rationale: readJsonBody JSON.parse throws 'Invalid JSON body: ...' (utils/http.ts L102) which the http.ts catch maps to badRequestResponse 400. Truncated JSON must be a clean 400, not a 500. SUPER_ADMIN passes the admin gate so the parse error is reached.

title: Create user with no email/firstName/lastName
rationale: createAdminUser reads input.firstName.trim()/lastName.trim(); with role present but names absent it throws 'Email, first name, and last name are required'. Proves required-field guard fires before user creation. (A bare access to input.firstName on undefined throws TypeError -> still surfaces as 400 via withAdminAuth, so 400 is correct either way.)

title: Create user with empty-string firstName
rationale: firstName is whitespace; input.firstName.trim() yields '' so the !firstName branch throws the required-fields error. Confirms trimming-then-required validation, not silent acceptance of blank names.

title: Create user with unknown role value
rationale: normalizeRole('WIZARD') is not in AUTH_ROLES/aliases so it throws AuthorizationError('Unknown role: WIZARD'). withAdminAuth maps AuthorizationError -> 403; a correct system could also treat invalid enum as 400, hence [400,403]. Message check pins the right rejection rather than an incidental error.

title: Non-super-admin assigns SUPER_ADMIN role on create (privilege escalation)
rationale: ADMIN_CSR_OPS holds admin.user_manage so it passes RBAC, but assertCanAssignRole throws plain Error 'Only a super admin can assign the SUPER_ADMIN or EXECUTIVE role.' -> withAdminAuth returns 400. Proves the self-escalation guard blocks minting privileged roles.

title: Non-super-admin assigns EXECUTIVE role on create
rationale: EXECUTIVE is in PRIVILEGED_ROLES; assertCanAssignRole blocks a non-SUPER_ADMIN from creating an EXECUTIVE user. Confirms both privileged roles are gated, not just SUPER_ADMIN.

title: SALES_BD_REP denied creating any user
rationale: POST /admin/users requires action admin.user_manage; SALES_BD_REP's ROLE_DEFAULT_ACTION_ACCESS lacks it, so assertActionAccess throws AuthorizationError -> 403. Default-deny RBAC for an operational role.

title: DEALER denied listing admin users
rationale: GET /admin/users requires admin.user_view; DEALER_PORTAL_USER only holds dealer.* actions, so the read is denied. Confirms portal users cannot enumerate internal user records.

title: EXECUTIVE (read-only oversight) denied creating a user
rationale: EXECUTIVE was hardened to a visibility-only role: it has admin.user_view but NOT admin.user_manage. assertActionAccess denies the write with 403. Proves view/manage separation for the oversight role.

title: Create user with an email that already exists
rationale: User.email has a unique constraint; creating a second user with an existing normalized email triggers a Prisma P2002 unique-violation inside the transaction, surfaced by withAdminAuth as 400 (a correct system may use 409). Harness should first create the fixture email then repeat it. Proves duplicate-email detection.

title: Repeat identical create after success yields duplicate, not second user
rationale: First call returns 201; an immediate identical replay must NOT mint a duplicate — the unique email constraint forces a duplicate rejection (400/409). Confirms create is not blindly idempotent-as-upsert and the second attempt is rejected.

title: SQL injection payload in displayName fields
rationale: firstName/lastName flow only through Prisma parameterized writes (displayName = `first last`). The payload must be stored verbatim as a string, not executed — expect a clean 201, never a 500 or DB error. Proves safe handling of injection text in free fields.

title: Emoji / multibyte unicode in name fields
rationale: No charset restriction exists on names; trim() preserves multibyte/emoji and displayName is a plain string. Expect 201 with the unicode persisted. Confirms UTF-8 safety end-to-end (no 500/encoding crash).

title: Oversize firstName (10k chars) within 1MB body limit
rationale: There is no explicit length cap in createAdminUser, but the displayName DB column has a bounded length. A 10k-char name either persists (201) or is rejected by a DB length constraint surfaced as 400 — never a 500. Probes for missing input-length validation at the boundary.

title: Huge 100k-char body field exceeding parser limit
rationale: readJsonBody enforces maxBytes=1_000_000; a 100k-char field is under that, so it parses, but a bounded DB column rejects it as 400. If total payload were over 1MB the body reader aborts (413/400). Confirms the request size / column bound is enforced, not a crash.

title: isActive sent as string instead of boolean
rationale: isActive is typed boolean but unvalidated at runtime: input.isActive ?? true passes the truthy string into Prisma's boolean column. Prisma rejects a non-boolean -> 400, or coercion yields 201. Documents whether the boundary type-checks isActive; either way must not 500.

title: Malformed JSON request body
rationale: readJsonBody catches JSON.parse failures and throws 'Invalid JSON body: ...'; withAdminAuth returns 400. Confirms malformed payloads are rejected with a specific parse error, not a 500.

title: Update a well-formed but nonexistent userId
rationale: updateAdminUser does findUnique then throws plain Error('User not found') when null; withAdminAuth surfaces it as 400 (a correct system may prefer 404). The message check pins the not-found semantics regardless of status mapping.

title: Reset password for nonexistent userId
rationale: resetAdminUserPassword findUnique returns null -> throws 'User not found'. Verifies reset-password 404 path and that no password is generated for a missing user.

title: Non-super-admin resets a SUPER_ADMIN/EXECUTIVE user's password
rationale: If {{userId}} resolves to a SUPER_ADMIN/EXECUTIVE, resetAdminUserPassword throws 'Only a super admin can reset the password of a SUPER_ADMIN or EXECUTIVE user.' (plain Error -> 400). Guards privileged-account password resets by a lower admin. Harness should point {{userId}} at a privileged fixture; otherwise this asserts the privileged-reset guard exists.

title: Reset password for a user lacking a LOCAL identity
rationale: resetAdminUserPassword throws 'User does not have a local password identity' when no LOCAL identity exists (e.g. an Entra-only user). For a LOCAL user it returns 200 with a temp password. Validates the SSO-only-account branch; the message check confirms the right rejection when applicable.

title: ADMIN_CSR_OPS demotes an existing SUPER_ADMIN user via PATCH
rationale: updateAdminUser: editing a user whose EXISTING role is privileged requires SUPER_ADMIN -> throws 'Only a super admin can modify a SUPER_ADMIN or EXECUTIVE user.' (400). Prevents a lower admin from tampering with privileged accounts even when downgrading. Harness should target a SUPER_ADMIN fixture.

title: Repeat identical PATCH update twice (idempotent no-op)
rationale: updateAdminUser recomputes displayName and writes the same value; a replayed identical PATCH must return 200 both times with no error and a fresh audit entry. Confirms updates are safely repeatable. Target a QA fixture {{userId}}, never seed data.

title: Update with empty body (no-op PATCH)
rationale: All UpdateAdminUserRequest fields are optional; with {} the service keeps existing email/name/role and skips isActive. Should return 200 unchanged. Confirms a partial/empty PATCH is accepted, not rejected as missing-field. Target a QA fixture.

title: FINANCE denied updating any user
rationale: PATCH requires admin.user_manage; FINANCE's action set has no admin.user_manage, so RBAC denies with 403 before any DB read. Default-deny for a non-admin operational role.

title: List users with negative page and over-max limit
rationale: listAdminUsers clamps: page = max(1, ...) and limit = min(100, max(1, ...)). page=-5 -> 1, limit=99999 -> 100. Expect 200 with page=1, limit=100 echoed. Proves pagination bounds are enforced server-side, not passed raw to skip/take.

title: List users with non-numeric page/limit query params
rationale: http handler does Number('abc') -> NaN; service uses input.page ?? 1 (NaN is not nullish so passes through), then Math.max(1, NaN)=NaN... actually Math.max(1,NaN)=NaN, but the harness must observe no crash. A correct system clamps NaN to defaults and returns 200. Flags any NaN-skip leakage; must not 500.

title: List users filtered by an invalid status enum
rationale: buildUserWhere only branches on ACTIVE/PENDING/INACTIVE; an unrecognized status falls through to no status filter (returns all). Expect 200 with an unfiltered list, never an error. Documents lenient enum handling on the status query param.

title: Script/SQL payload in users search query param
rationale: search flows into Prisma contains/insensitive (parameterized). The encoded `';--<script>` payload must be treated as a literal substring -> 200 with zero/normal matches, no 500 and no injection. Confirms safe handling of hostile search input.

title: TRAINING_OPS denied viewing role-access catalog
rationale: GET /admin/access/roles requires admin.role_view; TRAINING_OPS lacks it (only EXECUTIVE/SUPER_ADMIN/SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP/ADMIN_CSR_OPS hold it). 403 default-deny.

title: Activity feed with over-max and zero limit
rationale: listAdminActivity take = min(100, max(1, limit ?? 20)); limit=0 -> max(1,0)=1, so it returns at most 1 entry, never 0-or-error. Confirms the lower bound clamp on the audit feed limit.

title: REGIONAL_DIRECTOR denied reading system health
rationale: GET /admin/system-health requires admin.system_health_view, absent from REGIONAL_DIRECTOR's action set. 403. Confirms infra/health telemetry is gated from non-admin leadership.

title: ADMIN_CSR_OPS may view but EXECUTIVE may not manage integrations
rationale: PATCH /admin/integrations/auth requires admin.integration_manage; EXECUTIVE holds integration_view but NOT integration_manage, so the write is denied 403. Enforces view/manage split on the Entra SSO policy mutation.

title: SALES_BD_REP denied viewing integration status
rationale: GET /admin/integrations requires admin.integration_view; SALES_BD_REP lacks it. 403 default-deny so reps cannot read integration/secret-config health.

title: Update payment integration with invalid captureMode (coerced, not card-capture)
rationale: normalizeCaptureMode coerces anything != 'provider_runtime' to 'manual_recording', and normalizeVaultProvider coerces unknown providers to 'unknown'. Also allowCisCaptureTracking is force-set false (card capture parked post Apr-20). Expect 200 with sanitized policy — proves invalid enums cannot enable a raw card-capture mode.

title: Raw PAN injected into Entra allowedDomains free-text list
rationale: allowedDomains is free text normalized (trim/lowercase/dedupe) with no PAN/format validation, so a 16-digit test PAN would be stored as a 'domain'. A correct, PCI-aware system should reject or strip the card-number-shaped value (400/422) rather than persist {{PAN}} in a config flag's metadata. Flags missing PAN-scrubbing on admin free-text config and a domain-format gap. Must never 500.

title: Entra groupRoleMappings entry with an invalid role string
rationale: normalizeGroupRoleMappings wraps normalizeRole in try/catch and DROPS entries whose role is unknown. Expect 200 where the GANDALF mapping is silently discarded (effective mappings exclude it). Confirms invalid role-mappings are filtered, not persisted or 500'd.

title: Calendar integration pilotUserEmails sent as non-array
rationale: updateOutlookCalendarAdminSettings calls normalizeEmailList(input.pilotUserEmails) only when truthy; normalize uses Array.isArray and treats a non-array as empty. Expect 200 with pilotUserEmails coerced to [] (string ignored), or 400 if validated. Documents lenient array coercion; must not crash.

title: Import users with an empty rows array
rationale: importAdminUsers iterates input.rows; an empty array yields totalProcessed=0, successful=0, failed=0. Expect 200 with zeroed summary — a no-op import is valid, not an error. Confirms graceful empty-batch handling.

title: Bulk import where some rows are invalid (partial failure isolation)
rationale: importAdminUsers wraps each createAdminUser in try/catch, pushing failures into errors[] with the row index/message and continuing. Expect 200 with successful=1, failed=1, errors[0].message containing the unknown-role text. Proves per-row error isolation rather than aborting the whole batch or 500.

title: ADMIN_CSR_OPS bulk-imports a SUPER_ADMIN row (escalation via import)
rationale: Import calls createAdminUser per row, so assertCanAssignRole still fires; the SUPER_ADMIN row is rejected into errors[] (message 'Only a super admin can assign...'). Expect 200 overall with successful=0, failed=1 — the escalation guard cannot be bypassed via the bulk path.

title: Unauthenticated request to admin overview (no bearer token)
rationale: requireAuthenticatedActor throws AuthenticationError('Missing bearer token') when no Authorization header is present; withAdminAuth maps it to 401. (Harness must omit the token for this case despite the role label.) Confirms auth precedes RBAC and unauthenticated reads are blocked.

title: Trailing-slash userId segment resolves to empty id
rationale: pathname '/admin/users/' splits with filter(Boolean) so lastSegment becomes 'users' and userId logic; the handler guards '!userId' -> badRequest 'User id is required'. Probes the path-parsing boundary for an empty id segment. (Could also route to the collection handler -> 405.)

title: Malformed (non-UUID) userId on update
rationale: updateAdminUser passes 'not-a-uuid' to prisma findUnique on a UUID id column; Prisma throws an invalid-UUID/validation error caught by withAdminAuth -> 400 (a correct system may normalize to 404 not-found). Distinguishes malformed-id handling from genuine not-found; must not 500.

title: Create user with isActive explicitly false (provisioned-inactive)
rationale: input.isActive ?? true honors an explicit false; the new user is created inactive and deriveUserStatus returns INACTIVE (isActive=false short-circuits before lastLoginAt). Verifies the boolean default-vs-explicit boundary and that status derivation reflects it. QA fixture only.

title: Create dealer-kind user via admin (actorType=dealer)
rationale: UX-AD-011: actorType==='dealer' maps to UserKind.DEALER; the response summary's actorType should be 'dealer'. Confirms the explicit actor-kind branch works and is reflected in mapUserKind output. QA fixture.

title: Create product category with missing code
rationale: createProductCategory throws 'code is required' when !input.code?.trim(). Omitting code must be rejected, not silently defaulted; the catch in http.ts maps the thrown Error to badRequestResponse (400).

title: Create product category with whitespace-only name
rationale: name is validated via !input.name?.trim(), so a whitespace-only name fails the trim check exactly like an empty string and must throw 'name is required'. Proves trimming-before-required-check is enforced.

title: Create product category with duplicate code
rationale: ProductCategory.code is @unique in Prisma. The service has no pre-check, so a second insert with the same code triggers a P2002 unique-constraint error, caught and returned as a 4xx (badRequestResponse=400). The harness should create the first category, then re-POST the same code; correct behaviour is rejection, not a 500.

title: Create product category with 100k-char name
rationale: name maps to a Postgres text column with NO length cap and the service applies no max-length validation — only .trim(). A correct system either accepts it (201) or rejects with a request/body-size limit, but must NOT 500. Documents the absence of a max-length guard on category name.

title: SQL injection string in category code/name
rationale: All persistence is via Prisma parameterized queries, so a SQL payload must be stored/escaped safely (201) or rejected by validation (400) — never executed and never a 500. Confirms no string interpolation into raw SQL.

title: Create category with emoji + unicode name
rationale: No charset/format restriction exists on category name; only .trim() is applied. A correct system stores multibyte unicode and emoji without corruption and returns 201.

title: SALES_BD_REP denied creating a category (no module access)
rationale: SALES_BD_REP is absent from ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS['product_management'], so assertModuleAccess throws an AuthorizationError before any work, mapped to forbiddenResponse (403).

title: EXECUTIVE denied creating a category (view-only, no product.manage)
rationale: EXECUTIVE has the product_management module and product.view but NOT product.manage in ROLE_DEFAULT_ACTION_ACCESS. assertActionAccess('product.manage') throws → 403. Verifies action-level RBAC distinct from module-level.

title: Category cannot be its own parent on update
rationale: updateProductCategory throws 'Product category cannot be its own parent' when input.parentId === categoryId. Self-referential parent must be blocked to prevent a cyclic category tree.

title: Update non-existent category returns not-found
rationale: updateProductCategory does findUnique then throws 'Product category not found' for a well-formed but absent UUID. The generic catch returns 400; a correct system surfaces the not-found message rather than a 500.

title: Create product family with missing name
rationale: createProductFamily requires both code and name; with code present but name absent it throws 'name is required'. Confirms each required field is checked independently.

title: Create product family with duplicate code
rationale: ProductFamily.code is @unique. Creating the same code twice trips the unique constraint (P2002) which the catch maps to a 4xx — must be a clean rejection, not a 500.

title: Family sortOrder sent as string instead of number
rationale: sortOrder uses input.sortOrder ?? 100 with no numeric coercion/validation; a string is passed straight to Prisma's Int column, which rejects it (400). A correct system rejects the type-mismatch rather than 500-ing or silently storing garbage.

title: Update non-existent family
rationale: updateProductFamily throws 'Product family not found' for an absent UUID; caught and returned as 4xx with the not-found message.

title: Create catalog view with missing name
rationale: createDealerCatalogView throws 'name is required' when !input.name?.trim(). name is the only hard-required field; code auto-generates from kind/name when omitted.

title: Create catalog view with invalid kind enum
rationale: toDealerCatalogViewKind only uppercases the string with no whitelist check, so 'GALACTIC_OVERLORD' reaches Prisma's DealerCatalogViewKind enum column and fails — caught as 400. Confirms an unsupported kind cannot be persisted.

title: Update non-existent catalog view
rationale: updateDealerCatalogView throws 'Dealer catalog view not found' for an absent id. Verifies the existence guard before update.

title: Create catalog rule set with missing name
rationale: createCatalogRuleSet throws 'name is required' when name is blank. Rules are optional on create; name is the only required field.

title: Rule set rule with unsupported condition field
rationale: normalizeConditionArray validates each condition.field against CATALOG_RULE_CONDITION_FIELDS and throws 'Catalog rule condition has an unsupported field' otherwise. Proves condition fields are whitelisted.

title: Rule set rule with unsupported operator
rationale: normalizeConditionArray validates condition.operator against CATALOG_RULE_CONDITION_OPERATORS (is, is_not, is_any, is_empty, is_not_empty); 'contains' is rejected with 'unsupported operator'.

title: Rule with 'is' operator but no value
rationale: normalizeConditionArray requires a non-empty trimmed value for operators other than is_any/is_empty/is_not_empty, throwing 'Catalog rule conditions using "is" or "is not" need a selected value'. A whitespace value must fail this check.

title: Rule with empty conditions array
rationale: normalizeCatalogRuleDrafts throws 'Rule "r1" needs at least one condition' when the normalized conditions array is empty. A rule with no conditions is rejected.

title: assign_catalog_view rule with no dealerCatalogViewId
rationale: When resultAction is ASSIGN_CATALOG_VIEW and dealerCatalogViewId is empty, normalizeCatalogRuleDrafts throws 'Rule "r1" needs a Dealer Catalog View'. Enforces that an assignment action targets a concrete view.

title: Rule with unsupported resultAction
rationale: toCatalogRuleResultAction checks CATALOG_RULE_RESULT_ACTIONS (assign_catalog_view, require_review) and throws 'Catalog rule result action is not supported' for anything else.

title: Rule set with 51 rules exceeds the 50-rule cap
rationale: normalizeCatalogRuleDrafts throws 'Catalog rule set cannot contain more than 50 rules' when rules.length > 50. This 51-rule body is exactly one over the boundary and must be rejected; 50 would be accepted.

title: Activate non-existent rule set
rationale: activateCatalogRuleSet throws 'Catalog rule set not found' for an absent id before any state change. Confirms the existence guard on the publish action.

title: Update a rule set that is already ACTIVE is blocked
expectMessageContains: must be retired by activating a new draft
rationale: updateCatalogRuleSet throws 'Active catalog rules must be retired by activating a new draft' when before.status === ACTIVE. Editing a live rule set in place is an illegal transition; the harness should target an active rule set fixture ({{definitionId}}).

title: SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP denied activating rule set (no product.publish)
rationale: SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP has product_management module + product.view but lacks product.publish (only SUPER_ADMIN and ADMIN_CSR_OPS hold it). assertActionAccess('product.publish') throws → 403. Safe: activation never proceeds.

title: Create catalog inclusion with missing presentationId
rationale: createCatalogInclusion throws 'presentationId is required' when !input.presentationId?.trim(). The inclusion must be anchored to a presentation.

title: Create inclusion referencing a non-existent presentation
rationale: createCatalogInclusion does findUnique on the presentation and throws 'Product presentation not found' when absent. Verifies the FK target is validated before insert.

title: Create inclusion with an invalid effectiveFrom date
rationale: parseDateOrNull builds a Date and throws 'Invalid date: ...' when getTime() is NaN. A structurally impossible date (month 13, day 45) must be rejected, not coerced.

title: Create inclusion with far-future effective window
rationale: parseDateOrNull accepts any JS-parseable date and there is no from<=to ordering or upper-bound check in createCatalogInclusion. A correct system stores the far-future window (201); it must not 500. Documents the absence of an effectiveFrom<=effectiveTo guard.

title: Inclusion with invalid publishStatus enum
rationale: toProductPublishStatus only uppercases the value with no whitelist, so 'SUPER_PUBLISHED' reaches Prisma's ProductPublishStatus enum column and is rejected — caught as 400. Confirms invalid publish statuses cannot be stored.

title: Update non-existent catalog inclusion
rationale: updateCatalogInclusion throws 'Catalog inclusion not found' for an absent id before update.

title: PAN pasted into inclusion notes free-text
rationale: The PCI guard (assertNoRawPaymentCardData in utils/pci.ts) is imported by leads/cis/consignment/voice-notes but NOT by product-management, so a Luhn-valid PAN in inclusion.notes is currently stored (201). Per the PCI boundary policy (NFR-CIS-03/BR-L-08) the correct behaviour is a 400 rejection mentioning payment card. This case asserts the policy expectation and flags the gap if it returns 201.

title: TERRITORY_MANAGER denied publishing a snapshot (no module access)
rationale: TERRITORY_MANAGER is not in ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS['product_management'], so assertModuleAccess fails before publish logic → 403. Destructive publish never executes.

title: Publish snapshot for a non-existent catalog view
rationale: publishDealerCatalogSnapshot calls assertDealerCatalogViewExists which throws 'Dealer catalog view not found' for an absent id before building any snapshot.

title: Rollback to a snapshot that does not belong to the view
rationale: rollbackDealerCatalogSnapshot looks up the snapshot scoped to {id, dealerCatalogViewId} and throws 'Dealer catalog snapshot not found' when it cannot be found under that view. Prevents cross-view rollback.

title: List products with negative limit is clamped, not errored
rationale: clampLimit applies Math.min(Math.max(limit,1),200), so a negative limit is clamped to 1 and the request succeeds with 200. Confirms limit sanitisation rather than a 400/500 on bad pagination.

title: List products with oversize limit clamped to 200
rationale: clampLimit caps limit at MAX_LIMIT=200, so an absurd page size returns at most 200 rows with 200 OK. Verifies the upper bound is enforced server-side regardless of client input.

title: List products filtered by invalid publishStatus enum
rationale: buildProductWhere feeds toProductPublishStatus('BANANA') into a Prisma enum filter. Prisma rejects the unknown enum (caught → 400). A correct system either rejects (400) or returns an empty/ignored filter — it must not 500. Documents that query-param enums are not pre-validated.

title: Get product detail for a well-formed but absent id
rationale: getProductDetail returns null for an absent product and the route maps null to notFoundResponse (entity BaseProduct). This is the one route that returns a true 404 (not the catch-mapped 400), so the harness should expect a clean 404.

title: DEALER denied viewing the product catalog
rationale: DEALER (DEALER_PORTAL_USER) has neither the product_management module nor product.view in the RBAC matrix; assertModuleAccess in listProducts throws → 403. Internal catalog is not exposed to dealer-portal identities.

title: FINANCE denied listing categories (no module access)
rationale: FINANCE is absent from ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS['product_management'] and has no product.* action. assertModuleAccess('product_management') throws → 403 even for a read.

title: Repeat identical category create yields duplicate-code rejection
rationale: There is no idempotency key; createProductCategory always inserts. Because code is @unique, sending the exact same body twice makes the second call collide on the unique constraint (P2002) → 4xx. Proves the mutation is not silently duplicated and the second identical POST is rejected.

title: List products with whitespace-only search is ignored, returns 200
rationale: buildProductWhere only adds the OR search clause when input.search?.trim() is truthy, so a whitespace-only search collapses to an unfiltered list and returns 200. Confirms blank search terms do not error or over-filter.

title: Script/HTML payload in catalog view name stored safely
rationale: The API stores raw strings via Prisma and performs no HTML output-encoding at write time (encoding is a render concern). A correct API persists the literal string (201) or rejects (400) but must not 500 or execute it. Verifies XSS payloads are treated as inert data on the server boundary.

title: Activate a rule set that has zero rules
expectMessageContains: add at least one catalog rule before publishing
rationale: activateCatalogRuleSet throws 'Add at least one catalog rule before publishing' when before.rules.length === 0. An empty rule set cannot be promoted to ACTIVE; the harness should target a freshly-created DRAFT rule set with no rules.

title: Create asset with empty title is rejected
rationale: createDigitalAsset() throws 'title is required' when input.title.trim() is empty. A whitespace-only title must be rejected (caught -> badRequestResponse 400), not slugified into an empty asset.

title: Create asset with no title field at all
rationale: title is a required field with no default; the !input.title?.trim() guard fires when title is undefined and throws before any DB write.

title: Create asset with invalid kind enum
rationale: toAssetKind() upper-cases 'hologram' to 'HOLOGRAM' and hands it to Prisma's DigitalAssetKind enum column; Prisma rejects the unknown enum value, the error is caught and returned as 400 — not a 500 and not a silently-stored bad value.

title: Create asset with invalid visibility enum
rationale: visibility is coerced via toAssetVisibility().toUpperCase() then written to the DigitalAssetVisibility enum; 'SEMI_PUBLIC' is not a valid enum member, so Prisma rejects it and the handler returns 400.

title: Script/SQL payload in asset title is stored safely (no 500)
rationale: title is persisted via parameterized Prisma writes and slugify() strips non-alphanumerics for the slug; an injection string must be stored verbatim as data (201) with no SQL execution and no server error.

title: Oversize description on create is bounded, not a 500
rationale: description is a free-text column written through cleanNullable; a 100k-char string should either be accepted as data (201) or rejected by a column/json bound (400) — it must not produce an unhandled 500.

title: Unicode/emoji title slugifies without collision error
rationale: slugify() reduces non-[a-z0-9] runs to '-' and falls back to randomUUID() when the result is empty, so an all-unicode title yields a valid stableSlug and a 201 rather than a unique-constraint or empty-slug failure.

title: SALES_BD_REP cannot upload (create) an asset
rationale: POST /assets requires digital_asset.upload. SALES_BD_REP has view/download/share but NOT upload in ROLE_DEFAULT_ACTION_ACCESS, so assertActionAccess throws AuthorizationError -> forbiddenResponse 403.

title: FINANCE has no digital_assets module access at all
rationale: FINANCE is absent from ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS['digital_assets'] and lacks digital_asset.view; assertModuleAccess fires first and returns 403 even for a read.

title: DEALER role denied listing assets
rationale: DEALER_PORTAL_USER has neither the digital_assets module nor any digital_asset.* action; the request is rejected (403 on RBAC, or 401 if the dealer principal cannot satisfy requireAuthenticatedActor).

title: Get asset detail by nonexistent UUID returns 404
rationale: getDigitalAssetDetail returns null when findUnique misses; http.ts maps a null detail to notFoundResponse(DigitalAsset) -> 404.

title: List assets with malformed (non-UUID) detail id
rationale: A syntactically invalid id reaches prisma.findUnique on a uuid column; a correct system returns 404 (no match mapped to not-found) or 400 (Prisma validation caught) — never a 500.

title: List assets with absurd limit is clamped to MAX_LIMIT
rationale: clampLimit() caps take at MAX_LIMIT=200 (and floors at 1); an oversized limit must return 200 with a bounded page, not error or attempt an unbounded scan.

title: List assets with negative limit is floored to 1
rationale: Math.max(limit,1) in clampLimit() floors any negative/zero limit to 1, so a negative query param yields a valid 200 response rather than a Prisma 'take must be positive' error.

title: List assets with invalid status filter enum
rationale: buildAssetWhere maps status through toAssetStatus().toUpperCase() to where.status; 'DELETED' is not a DigitalAssetStatus enum value, so Prisma rejects the where clause and the handler returns 400.

title: Edit-only grant cannot publish (set visibility public) - needs publish action
rationale: PATCH requires digital_asset.edit, which TRAINING_OPS lacks entirely; assertActionAccess('digital_asset.edit') throws before the publish sub-gate is even reached -> 403. (Confirms edit gate precedes the not-found path.)

title: Update nonexistent asset returns not-found
rationale: updateDigitalAsset throws 'Digital asset not found' when the before-row is missing; that error is caught by the handler's generic catch and surfaced as a 400 (no dedicated 404 mapping for this path).

title: Create version with no file reference is rejected
rationale: createDigitalAssetVersionRow requires at least one of storageKey/externalUrl/fileBase64; with only fileName it throws 'storageKey, externalUrl, or fileBase64 is required'. (Asset-not-found also yields 400, both confirming no 500.)

title: Create version with missing fileName is rejected
rationale: createDigitalAssetVersionRow throws 'fileName is required' when fileName is absent/blank; this validation runs inside the transaction and aborts with a 400.

title: REGIONAL_DIRECTOR cannot create a version (upload denied)
rationale: Version creation requires digital_asset.upload; REGIONAL_DIRECTOR has view/download/share/usage_view but not upload, so it is denied with 403 before any asset lookup.

title: Create collection with missing code
rationale: createDigitalAssetCollection throws 'code is required' when input.code.trim() is empty/absent, before the DB insert.

title: Create collection with code but blank name
rationale: After the code check, createDigitalAssetCollection throws 'name is required' for a whitespace-only name -> 400.

title: Duplicate collection code violates unique constraint
rationale: code is a unique column on DigitalAssetCollection; reusing an existing collection's code triggers a Prisma P2002 unique-constraint error that is caught and returned as 400 (or 409) rather than creating a second row or 500ing.

title: SALES_BD_REP cannot create a collection (edit denied)
rationale: Collection creation requires digital_asset.edit; SALES_BD_REP lacks edit (has only view/download/share) -> assertActionAccess throws 403.

title: Add item to nonexistent collection
rationale: upsertDigitalAssetCollectionItem throws 'Digital asset collection not found' when the collection is missing (checked before the asset); caught and surfaced as 400 (no dedicated 404 mapping).

title: Upsert same collection item twice is idempotent
rationale: The item is keyed on the composite collectionId_assetId via prisma.upsert, so repeating the call is non-duplicating by design; with a nonexistent assetId the asset-existence guard throws 'Digital asset not found' (400). Repeating the request must yield the same deterministic rejection, proving no partial/duplicate write.

title: Collection item with negative sortOrder
rationale: sortOrder has no explicit lower-bound validation (defaults to 100 only when undefined); an extreme/negative Int still hits the asset-existence guard which rejects the nonexistent asset (400). Confirms a boundary integer does not 500 the Int column.

title: Product assignment missing required role
rationale: role is required; toAssetRole(undefined) -> undefined.toUpperCase() throws, or the findFirst/create with an undefined role enum fails — caught and returned as 400, not 500.

title: Product assignment with invalid role enum
rationale: toAssetRole('hero_banner') -> 'HERO_BANNER' is not a ProductAssetRole enum member; Prisma rejects it on the where/create and the error becomes a 400.

title: SALES_BD_REP cannot link product assets
rationale: product-assignments is gated on module product_management + action product.asset_link. SALES_BD_REP has neither, so requireAuthenticatedActor's access check throws 403.

title: Product assignment version must belong to the asset
rationale: assignProductAsset looks up assetVersionId and throws 'Digital asset version not found' (or 'does not belong to the selected asset' if it resolves to a different asset); both abort the transaction with a 400.

title: Unlink nonexistent product assignment
rationale: unlinkProductAsset throws 'Product asset assignment not found' when findUnique misses, caught and returned as 400 — safe because it targets a nonexistent id, never seed data.

title: Cannot share an internal_only asset
rationale: createDigitalAssetShareLink enforces a share state machine: missing asset throws 'Digital asset not found'; for a real internal_only asset it throws 'Only dealer portal or public assets can be shared externally'. Both are caught as 400, proving internal assets are not externally shareable.

title: EXECUTIVE cannot create share links (share denied)
rationale: Share-link creation requires digital_asset.share. EXECUTIVE is a read/oversight role with view+download+usage_view only (hardened 2026-06-22) and lacks share -> 403.

title: Share link with far-future expiry beyond 365-day cap
rationale: resolveShareExpiry clamps expiresInDays to MAX_SHARE_EXPIRY_DAYS=365, so an absurd expiry can never exceed one year; against a nonexistent asset the 'Digital asset not found' guard fires first (400/404). Confirms the cap path and that the request never errors on the large number itself.

title: Share link with explicit past expiresAt date
rationale: explicit expiresAt is taken as-is via parseDateOrNull (no future-date guard); a past date is accepted into the field. Against a missing asset the not-found guard returns 400/404 — verifying a past expiresAt does not crash parsing and the resolve path would later treat it as expired.

title: Share link with unparseable expiresAt string
rationale: parseDateOrNull returns null for an invalid date string (never throws), so the share link would persist with a null expiry; against the nonexistent asset the not-found guard returns 400/404. Confirms invalid date input degrades gracefully, not a 500.

title: Revoke a nonexistent share link is not enumerable
rationale: revokeDigitalAssetShareLink throws 'Digital asset share link not found' for a missing id; the same message is returned when a share-only actor targets someone else's link, so links are not enumerable. Caught as 400/404.

title: Public share resolve with script/path-traversal token returns not-found
rationale: resolveDigitalAssetShareLink hashes the token (sha256) and does an exact tokenHash lookup; a traversal/garbage token simply misses and throws 'Digital asset share link not found' (400/404). No filesystem access occurs and the token is never used as a path.

title: Widen manifest path traversal is blocked
rationale: resolveManifestPathWithinRoot strips leading separators and confines the path to the widen-manifests subdir; a '../' traversal resolves outside the base and throws 'Widen manifest path resolved outside the configured manifest directory' -> 400, preventing arbitrary file reads.

title: TRAINING_OPS cannot run a Widen import (sync denied)
rationale: Widen preview/commit require digital_asset.sync. TRAINING_OPS has view/download/share/usage_view and product.asset_link but NOT sync -> assertActionAccess throws 403.

title: Widen commit with no rows is rejected
rationale: commitWidenManifestImport throws 'Widen manifest rows are required before committing an import run' when context.rows is empty and dryRun is not set, so an empty commit cannot create a no-op batch.

title: Widen dryRun preview with empty rows returns a zeroed summary (200)
rationale: previewWidenManifestImport never requires rows; with an empty array it returns a 200 summary (sourceRecordCount 0, validRowCount 0) plus the 'No Widen manifest rows were supplied' warning. Confirms preview is a safe, non-mutating read.

title: Widen rows sent as object instead of array
rationale: loadWidenManifestRows only treats input.rows as rows when Array.isArray is true; a non-array rows value is ignored, falls through to the 'no rows supplied' warning, and returns a 200 empty preview rather than throwing on the wrong type.

title: Widen import run limit is clamped (list, max 50)
rationale: listWidenManifestImportRuns clamps limit via Math.min(Math.max(limit,1),50); an oversized limit returns 200 with at most 50 batches, never an unbounded query.

title: PAN pasted into asset description is stored without payment-card rejection (gap)
bodyJson: {"title":"QA PAN Desc","kind":"other","description":"call me, card on file {{PAN}}"}
rationale: A PCI guard (utils/pci.ts assertNoPaymentCard, message 'appears to contain payment card data') exists for CIS/lead free-text but is NOT wired into the digital-assets service. A correct system should reject a Luhn-valid PAN in the description with a payment-card message (400); this case asserts that correct behaviour and will surface the missing-guard gap if the asset is created (201) instead.

title: PAN in share-link recipient note must be rejected
rationale: share-link note is free text persisted verbatim (cleanNullable) with no PCI scan. A correct system rejects a PAN in the note with a payment-card message; here the asset-not-found guard returns 400/404 first. The case documents that a real approved/shareable asset would currently store the PAN — a PCI gap to confirm.

title: Empty JSON body on asset create
rationale: An empty object has no title, so the !input.title?.trim() guard throws 'title is required' -> 400. Confirms the handler does not NPE on a bare body.

title: Asset create with title as a number (wrong type)
rationale: input.title?.trim() assumes a string; a numeric title makes .trim() throw (or the !input.title?.trim() guard treats it inconsistently), and the error is caught and returned as 400 rather than a 500. Confirms type coercion is handled at the boundary.

title: Asset stableSlug at/over 180-char-ish bound from LONG title
rationale: slugify() builds the slug from a 10k-char title with no length truncation in createDigitalAsset (unlike the Widen path which .slice(0,180)). The system must either store it (201) or reject on the slug column length (400) — not 500. Surfaces whether the slug column bound is enforced safely.

title: Workspace with no startDate or endDate query params
rationale: http.ts reads startDate/endDate from searchParams; if either is missing it returns badRequestResponse('startDate and endDate are required') BEFORE auth/service. Proves required-param guard fires.

title: Workspace with startDate present but endDate missing
rationale: The guard `if (!startDate || !endDate)` requires BOTH; endDate absent must reject. Off-by-one on the AND/OR pair.

title: Workspace with whitespace-only startDate (trimmed to empty)
rationale: http.ts calls `.trim()` on the param; whitespace becomes '' which is falsy, hitting the required-field branch. Confirms trim-then-check ordering, not a downstream ISO parse error.

title: Workspace with non-ISO garbage startDate
expectMessageContains: startdate must be a valid iso date
rationale: parseCalendarRange→parseIsoDate does `new Date(value)`; NaN getTime throws 'startDate must be a valid ISO date', caught by the route try/catch as badRequest. Proves date parsing rejects junk, not 500.

title: Workspace with invalid calendar date (Feb 30) as endDate
rationale: JS Date rolls 2026-02-30 to early March 2026, which is BEFORE startDate 2026-06-01, so the endDate<startDate branch throws 'endDate must be on or after startDate'. Either branch yields 400; a correct system never returns 500 for a nonsense calendar date.

title: Workspace where endDate is before startDate
expectMessageContains: enddate must be on or after startdate
rationale: parseCalendarRange throws when rangeEnd.getTime() < rangeStart.getTime(). Explicit ordering business rule.

title: Workspace with start==end (zero-length range)
rationale: endDate==startDate passes the `<` check (not strictly less) and rangeDays=0 <= 180. Lower boundary must succeed and return a valid workspace payload.

title: Workspace range exactly 180 days (max allowed)
rationale: MAX_CALENDAR_RANGE_DAYS=180; ceil of a 180-day span equals 180, and the guard is `> 180`. The boundary value must be accepted (off-by-one upper edge).

title: Workspace range 181 days (one past max)
rationale: ceil((181 days)/86400000) = 181 > 180 throws the explicit range-cap error. Upper-bound off-by-one rejection.

title: Workspace with absurdly far-future range (years) exceeding cap
rationale: Far-future endDate yields a multi-thousand-day span, must hit the 180-day cap rather than attempting an unbounded DB scan.

title: Workspace with deep-past dates within a valid 180-day window
rationale: Epoch-era dates are valid ISO and span <180 days; service should return an empty/valid workspace (no events that old) without error. Confirms past dates are allowed, only range size is capped.

title: Workspace with array-style repeated startDate params
rationale: URLSearchParams.get returns the FIRST value only; duplicate params must not crash — the route uses the first valid ISO date and succeeds. Proves robust query handling, not a 500.

title: SQL injection string in startDate query param
expectMessageContains: must be a valid iso date
rationale: The injection payload is not a parseable Date, so parseIsoDate throws the ISO-validation error. Confirms input is treated as a date string (rejected) and never concatenated into SQL — no 500, no data loss (Prisma is parameterized regardless).

title: Emoji/unicode payload in endDate query param
expectMessageContains: enddate must be a valid iso date
rationale: Emoji string is not a valid Date; parseIsoDate('endDate') throws. Verifies unicode is safely rejected at the ISO boundary, not 500.

title: Workspace with 10k-char LONG string as startDate
expectMessageContains: startdate must be a valid iso date
rationale: An oversize non-date string must be rejected by parseIsoDate, not buffer/crash the handler. Confirms graceful handling of oversize query input.

title: Workspace request with no bearer token
rationale: requireAuthenticatedActor throws AuthenticationError('Missing bearer token') when no Authorization header; the route maps it to unauthorizedResponse. (Harness must omit the token for this case.)

title: Dealer reading admin Entra/Graph calendar governance settings
rationale: Entra/Graph governance lives under /admin/integrations/calendar requiring module 'admin' + action 'admin.integration_view'. DEALER_PORTAL_USER has neither admin module nor the action, so assertModuleAccess/assertActionAccess throws AuthorizationError -> 403.

title: Sales rep updating Outlook governance policy (Entra/Graph)
rationale: PATCH requires action 'admin.integration_manage'. SALES_BD_REP lacks both the admin module and that action -> AuthorizationError -> 403. Governance write must be denied to non-admins.

title: Sales leadership (has admin module, lacks integration_manage) updating calendar governance
rationale: SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP IS in the admin module but its action list lacks 'admin.integration_manage' (only role/audit/health views). assertActionAccess must reject. Tests module-pass-but-action-fail RBAC layering.

title: Admin calendar governance update with invalid meeting provider enum
rationale: updateOutlookCalendarAdminSettings runs normalizeMeetingProvider which coerces any non-'teams' value to 'none' (no throw). A correct system accepts the request and stores 'none' — proves enum is normalized, not 500. Response policy.defaultMeetingProvider should be 'none'.

title: Admin calendar governance update with non-array pilotUserEmails string
